title: 645. The Fall of the Incas: Massacre in the Andes (Part 2)

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Now, we promised that we would be back with more news about the thrilling
sentences.zh: 我们之前承诺过，会带来更多关于激动人心的

sentences.en: Rest is History Festival.
sentences.zh: “历史就是历史”节（Rest is History Festival）的消息。

sentences.en: And we can now reveal some more of the massive names who will be joining us at Hampton Court Palace on the 4th and 5th of July this year.
sentences.zh: 现在我们可以揭晓更多将在今年7月4日和5日于汉普顿宫加入我们的重磅嘉宾名单了。

sentences.en: One of them is the brilliant
sentences.zh: 其中一位是才华横溢的

sentences.en: Tracy Borman, who will be joining us to talk about the secrets of the Tudors.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西·博曼（Tracy Borman），她将加入我们，讲述都铎王朝的秘密。

sentences.en: And the other, another massive fan favourite is Katja Hoyer, who will be talking about her new work on
sentences.zh: 另一位是备受粉丝喜爱的卡佳·霍耶（Katja Hoyer），她将谈论她关于

sentences.en: Weimar Germany.
sentences.zh: 魏玛德国的新作。

sentences.en: So I will be joined by Mary Beard to talk about what else Rome.
sentences.zh: 届时，玛丽·比尔德（Mary Beard）将与我一同探讨——还能是什么呢——罗马。

sentences.en: And I will also be joined by friend of the show, Ali Ansari, to talk about what else Persia.
sentences.zh: 我还将与节目的老朋友阿里·安萨里（Ali Ansari）一起探讨——还能是什么呢——波斯。

sentences.en: I will also be joined by massive fan favourite and Irish national treasure, Paul Rouse, who will be joining us to talk about the history of Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我还将与备受粉丝喜爱、被誉为爱尔兰国宝的保罗·劳斯（Paul Rouse）一同探讨爱尔兰历史。

sentences.en: And I will be joined by Helen Castor to talk about, very appropriately, considering that we're at Hampton Court, Elizabeth I.
sentences.zh: 海伦·卡斯托（Helen Castor）也将加入我，考虑到我们身处汉普顿宫，探讨伊丽莎白一世再合适不过了。

sentences.en: A few names left to announce, and you'll be able to find the full line-up on the new Rest is History website very soon.
sentences.zh: 还有几位嘉宾待宣布，很快你们就能在全新的“历史就是历史”网站上看到完整的阵容。

sentences.en: But Tom, the one thing that's puzzling me, how will our listeners be able to join us at this new festival?
sentences.zh: 但是汤姆，有一件事让我很困惑，我们的听众该如何参加这个新节日呢？

sentences.en: Well, Dominic, the answer is very simple.
sentences.zh: 嗯，多米尼克，答案很简单。

sentences.en: They will have to become members of the Rest is History Club, because this festival is exclusive to members of the Rest is History Club.
sentences.zh: 他们必须成为“历史就是历史”俱乐部的会员，因为这个节日仅对俱乐部会员开放。

sentences.en: If you are a member, you can enter the ballot for two tickets.
sentences.zh: 如果你是会员，就可以参加两张门票的抽签。

sentences.en: Now, you might think, I actually don't want to enter the ballot.
sentences.zh: 你可能会想，我其实不想参加抽签。

sentences.en: I'd like guaranteed tickets.
sentences.zh: 我想要确保能买到票。

sentences.en: And the way to do that is to become an Athelstan, because if you're one of our Athelstan members, then you are guaranteed access to two tickets.
sentences.zh: 实现这一点的办法就是成为一名“埃塞尔斯坦”（Athelstan）会员，因为如果你是我们的一名埃塞尔斯坦会员，就能确保获得两张门票。

sentences.en: So, you are going to receive full details via email, and if you would like any extra information on the festival, on the ballot, on the guests,
sentences.zh: 所以，你们会通过电子邮件收到详细信息，如果你们想了解关于节日、抽签、嘉宾的任何额外信息，

sentences.en: whatever, then click the link in the episode description.
sentences.zh: 或者其他任何事，请点击剧集描述中的链接。

sentences.en: So, for a chance to join us at the inaugural Rest is History Festival, sign up to the club today
sentences.zh: 所以，想要有机会参加我们首届“历史就是历史”节，今天就注册成为俱乐部会员吧，

sentences.en: at therestishistory.com, because believe me, this is something that you won't want to miss.
sentences.zh: 网址是therestishistory.com，相信我，这绝对是你不想错过的活动。

sentences.en: Have you ever climbed a mountain in full armour?
sentences.zh: 你有没有试过穿着全套盔甲爬山？

sentences.en: Well, that's what we did.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们就是这么做的。

sentences.en: Pizarro going first the whole way up a tiny path into the clouds, with drops sheer on both sides into nothing.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗一路走在最前面，沿着一条没入云端的小径，两侧都是深不见底的悬崖。

sentences.en: For hours, we crept forward like blind men, the sweat freezing on our faces, lugging skittery, leaking horses, and pricked all the time for the ambush that would tip us into death.
sentences.zh: 几个小时里，我们像瞎子一样摸索前行，汗水在脸上结了冰，拖着受惊、渗水的马匹，时刻警惕着可能将我们推向死亡的伏击。

sentences.en: Each turn of the path, it grew colder.
sentences.zh: 小径每转一个弯，天气就更冷一些。

sentences.en: The friendly trees of the forest dropped away, and there were only pines.
sentences.zh: 森林里友好的树木消失了，只剩下松树。

sentences.en: Then they went too, and there just scrubby little bushes standing up in ice.
sentences.zh: 接着松树也没了，只剩下冰雪中伫立的灌木丛。

sentences.en: All round us, the rocks began to whine with cold.
sentences.zh: 我们周围，岩石开始因寒冷而发出哀鸣。

sentences.en: And always, above us or below us, those filthy condor birds hanging on the air with great tasseled wings.
sentences.zh: 而在我们上方或下方，总有那些肮脏的秃鹫，用巨大的流苏翅膀悬在空中。

sentences.en: Then night, we lay down twos and threes together on the path, and hugged like lovers for warmth in that burning cold.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，我们两三个一组躺在小径上，在那灼人的寒冷中像恋人一样紧紧相拥取暖。

sentences.en: And most cried.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都哭了。

sentences.en: We got up with cold iron for bones and went on.
sentences.zh: 我们拖着如冷铁般的骨头起身，继续前行。

sentences.en: Four days like that, groaning, not speaking the breath, a blade in our lungs.
sentences.zh: 就这样过了四天，呻吟着，连呼吸都不敢大声，肺部像被刀割一样。

sentences.en: Four days slowly like flies on a wall, limping flies, dying flies, up an endless wall of rock.
sentences.zh: 四天，像墙上的苍蝇一样缓慢爬行，瘸腿的苍蝇，垂死的苍蝇，爬上一面无尽的岩壁。

sentences.en: A tiny army lost in the creases of the moon.
sentences.zh: 一支迷失在月球褶皱里的微小军队。

sentences.en: So that was old Martin in Peter Schaffer's play, The Royal Hunt of the Sun, which came out in 1964.
sentences.zh: 以上就是彼得·谢弗（Peter Shaffer）1964年创作的剧作《太阳的皇家狩猎》（The Royal Hunt of the Sun）中老马丁的台词。

sentences.en: I'm going to confess, I had no idea really how to play him.
sentences.zh: 我得承认，我真的不知道该怎么演他。

sentences.en: I've tried out a range of tones and accents and voices.
sentences.zh: 我尝试了各种语调、口音和声音。

sentences.en: The voice changed from line to line, no?
sentences.zh: 声音从一句台词变到下一句，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, it did.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实变了。

sentences.en: Dominic, I'm assuming that all the readings for the series are going to be coming from this play, are they?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我假设这个系列的所有朗读片段都来自这部剧，是吗？

sentences.en: No, I don't think they are.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得不是。

sentences.en: Oh, because I thought that over the process of the six episodes we're doing, I could, maybe by episode six, I would finalise how old Martin should actually have spoken.
sentences.zh: 哦，因为我原以为在我们制作的这六集节目里，我可以在第六集之前确定老马丁到底应该是什么样的语调。

sentences.en: Because his narrative stops too soon.
sentences.zh: 因为他的叙述结束得太早了。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, we'll have to find some other readings for the later episodes.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们得为后面的剧集找些其他的朗读材料。

sentences.en: Okay, so whatever one thinks of old Martin and how he should be speaking, what he is doing there
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么无论人们怎么看待老马丁以及他应该如何说话，他在这里所做的

sentences.en: is describe the point in our story where the Spanish conquistadors are inching their way through the Andes towards their showdown with the Inca Emperor Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 是描述了我们故事中的那个时刻：西班牙征服者们正艰难地穿过安第斯山脉，前往与印加皇帝阿塔瓦尔帕的决战之地。

sentences.en: And Dominic, we've said it before, we're going to say it again, this is one of the most dramatic confrontations in history.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我们之前说过，还要再说一遍，这是历史上最戏剧性的对峙之一。

sentences.en: It is up there with Cortez meeting Moctezuma.
sentences.zh: 它足以与科尔特斯会见蒙特祖马相提并论。

sentences.en: It is that seismic.
sentences.zh: 它是如此震撼。

sentences.en: It is, absolutely it is.
sentences.zh: 确实，绝对是。

sentences.en: It's an amazing scene in the play actually.
sentences.zh: 这在剧中确实是一个令人惊叹的场景。

sentences.en: So it ends with the Spanish on the hillside above the town of Cayamaca where they're due to meet Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 故事结束于西班牙人站在卡哈马卡镇上方的山坡上，他们将在那里会见阿塔瓦尔帕。

sentences.en: And Martin says, you could almost touch the silence.
sentences.zh: 马丁说，你几乎可以触碰到那份寂静。

sentences.en: Up on the hill, we could see the Inca's tents and the light from his fires ringing the valley.
sentences.zh: 在山上，我们可以看到印加人的帐篷，以及环绕山谷的篝火光芒。

sentences.en: It's the sense of gathering tension and excitement, very, very dramatic moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一种紧张感和兴奋感不断积聚的氛围，非常、非常戏剧性的时刻。

sentences.en: And that is the story we are telling today.
sentences.zh: 而这就是我们今天要讲述的故事。

sentences.en: So they're meeting with Atahualpa and what happens next.
sentences.zh: 所以他们要会见阿塔瓦尔帕，接下来会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: So let's just remind listeners where we got to.
sentences.zh: 让我们先提醒一下听众我们讲到哪里了。

sentences.en: So the year's 1532.
sentences.zh: 现在是1532年。

sentences.en: The veteran conquistador Francisco Pizarro has landed in Peru with around
sentences.zh: 老练的征服者弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗带着大约

sentences.en: 200 men looking for adventure, for glory, and for gold.
sentences.zh: 200人登陆秘鲁，寻找冒险、荣耀和黄金。

sentences.en: And he is convinced that somewhere south along the Pacific coast is this rich and sophisticated kingdom.
sentences.zh: 他确信在太平洋沿岸向南的某个地方，存在着一个富有且文明的王国。

sentences.en: And of course he is right.
sentences.zh: 当然，他是对的。

sentences.en: This kingdom is Tawantinsoyo, the land of the four quarters, or as we would call it, the empire of the Incas.
sentences.zh: 这个王国就是“塔万廷苏尤”（Tawantinsuyu），即“四方之地”，或者按我们的叫法，印加帝国。

sentences.en: One of the largest empires in the world at this point.
sentences.zh: 这是当时世界上最大的帝国之一。

sentences.en: From their heartland in Cuzco, the Incas rule about 12 million people, all the way from Colombia and Ecuador in the north to Chile in the south.
sentences.zh: 印加人以库斯科为中心，统治着约1200万人，疆域北至哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔，南至智利。

sentences.en: Pizarro has made a stunning discovery.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗有一个惊人的发现。

sentences.en: He's landed at a place called Tumbes and he has discovered that the empire is in chaos.
sentences.zh: 他在一个叫通贝斯（Tumbes）的地方登陆，发现帝国正处于混乱之中。

sentences.en: There's been ravaged by smallpox and by this fratricidal civil war between two claimants to the
sentences.zh: 它遭受了天花的蹂躏，以及两位王位觊觎者之间的手足相残的内战，

sentences.en: throne, Huascar, the older brother, who is based in Cuzco, and Atahualpa, the younger, who is formerly his viceroy in Quito in Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 一位是身在库斯科的哥哥瓦斯卡尔（Huascar），另一位是弟弟阿塔瓦尔帕（Atahualpa），他曾是瓦斯卡尔在厄瓜多尔基多的总督。

sentences.en: So a very Game of Thrones style struggle for the throne.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场非常《权力的游戏》风格的王位争夺战。

sentences.en: And now Pizarro and his men.
sentences.zh: 现在皮萨罗和他的手下们——

sentences.en: So that is his brothers, Hernando Gonzalo and Juan, and his lieutenant Hernando de Soto, great horseman, posh but sinister and short.
sentences.zh: 也就是他的兄弟埃尔南多、贡萨洛和胡安，以及他的副手埃尔南多·德·索托，一位伟大的骑手，时髦但阴险且个子不高——

sentences.en: They can see their opening.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了机会。

sentences.en: If they can profit from the Incas divisions, then maybe they can emulate Pizarro's cousin, Hernando Cortes, the conqueror of the Aztecs.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能利用印加人的分裂，也许就能效仿皮萨罗的表亲，阿兹特克征服者埃尔南·科尔特斯。

sentences.en: So let's pick up the story from where we left off.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们从上次中断的地方继续讲起。

sentences.en: It is midwinter, which means it's what we would call summer in Peru.
sentences.zh: 现在是仲冬，这意味着在秘鲁正是我们所说的夏天。

sentences.en: Pizarro is still in the far northwestern corner.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗仍然在西北角的远端。

sentences.en: He is about 900 miles north of modern-day Lima.
sentences.zh: 他距离现代的利马大约有900英里。

sentences.en: So that is about 1,300 miles north of Cuzco, the Inca capital.
sentences.zh: 也就是距离印加首都库斯科大约1300英里。

sentences.en: Is there a road that goes straight there though?
sentences.zh: 不过有直达那里的路吗？

sentences.en: No, a series of roads.
sentences.zh: 没有，是一系列道路。

sentences.en: The Incas have built this incredible road network.
sentences.zh: 印加人建造了这套令人难以置信的道路网络。

sentences.en: So it's actually not as far as it might sound.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上并没有听起来那么远。

sentences.en: Well, it's still far, but it's-
sentences.zh: 嗯，还是很远，但是——

sentences.en: Yeah, but it's, you know, you don't have to hack your way through jungles or anything.
sentences.zh: 是的，但是，你知道，你不需要在丛林里开路什么的。

sentences.en: No, there's not too much hacking, but there's a lot of crossing of rope bridges.
sentences.zh: 不，不需要太多开路，但有很多绳桥要过。

sentences.en: And everyone knows that's dangerous.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道那很危险。

sentences.en: Vertiginous ascents and descents and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 令人眩晕的攀爬和下降之类的。

sentences.en: Llama action.
sentences.zh: 还有羊驼。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But Pizarro wants to make sure that his governorship that he has been awarded by the
sentences.zh: 但皮萨罗想确保他从西班牙国王那里获得的统治权

sentences.en: Spanish king is on firm foundations.
sentences.zh: 有坚实的基础。

sentences.en: So the first thing he does is to establish a new town.
sentences.zh: 所以他做的第一件事就是建立一座新城镇。

sentences.en: This is from his cousin Cortez's Mexican playbook.
sentences.zh: 这是他表亲科尔特斯的墨西哥剧本里的招数。

sentences.en: This is what Cortez had done.
sentences.zh: 这就是科尔特斯做过的事。

sentences.en: You establish a town, you establish a municipal government, and that gives you the legal foundation that means you can't be challenged for governorship of this country.
sentences.zh: 你建立一个城镇，建立一个市政政府，这就给了你法律基础，意味着你对这个国家的统治权不会受到质疑。

sentences.en: Can I ask you, Dominic, what has Charles V licensed Pizarro to do?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我可以问一下，查理五世授权皮萨罗做什么了吗？

sentences.en: Is the notion that
sentences.zh: 是不是认为

sentences.en: Pizarro will turn up, found a city, and that the Incas will be so peaceable that they'll just go, that's great?
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗会出现，建立一个城市，而印加人会非常平和，只会说“那太棒了”？

sentences.en: And if they don't, is there a license to kind of attack them with horses and gunpowder and stuff?
sentences.zh: 如果他们不这么做，是否有授权可以用马匹和火药之类的东西攻击他们？

sentences.en: So as we will discover, under the regulations from, I think, 1513, the Council of Castile,
sentences.zh: 正如我们将要发现的，根据我认为是1513年卡斯蒂利亚议会的规定，

sentences.en: you read them this thing called the requirement, which explains to them the history of the world,
sentences.zh: 你要向他们宣读一份名为“要求书”（The Requirement）的文件，向他们解释世界历史、

sentences.en: the story of Jesus, and the fact that Charles V, the king of Spain, has been licensed by the Pope to export Christianity to the Americas.
sentences.zh: 耶稣的故事，以及西班牙国王查理五世已获得教皇授权向美洲输出基督教的事实。

sentences.en: When you read them this, they are legally bound
sentences.zh: 当你向他们宣读这些时，他们在法律上有义务

sentences.en: to submit to vassalage.
sentences.zh: 臣服并成为附庸。

sentences.en: And if they don't, you can kill them.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不从，你就可以杀死他们。

sentences.en: So that essentially is the legal framework.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上就是法律框架。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: But is Pizarro expecting that he's going to have to fight?
sentences.zh: 但皮萨罗是否预料到他必须进行战斗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm sure he is.
sentences.zh: 是的，我肯定他预料到了。

sentences.en: Or is he hoping that perhaps they could arrive at a mutually acceptable accommodation?
sentences.zh: 还是他希望也许他们能达成某种双方都能接受的妥协？

sentences.en: I think ideally they'll reach an accommodation, but violence is always part of the Spanish repertoire.
sentences.zh: 我想理想情况下他们会达成妥协，但暴力始终是西班牙人手段的一部分。

sentences.en: And everywhere the Spanish have been, so in the Caribbean, in Albury Island, in Mesoamerica, in Central America, everywhere they have been, theatrical terror has been an
sentences.zh: 无论西班牙人去过哪里，比如加勒比海、阿尔伯里岛、中美洲，无论他们去过哪里，戏剧性的恐怖一直是他们

sentences.en: important part of their armory.
sentences.zh: 武器库中的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: I just wonder though, because it is very punchy, even by the stance of the Spanish, to invade an empire consisting of 12 million people with under 200 people.
sentences.zh: 但我只是好奇，因为即便以西班牙人的标准来看，用不到200人去入侵一个拥有1200万人口的帝国，也是非常大胆的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, some people might say, you might say bonkers if it were not for the fact that we all know that they do it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些人可能会说，如果不是因为我们都知道他们确实做到了，你可能会说这简直是疯了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: So he's thinking he's going to get reinforcements, that they're going to arrive at any moment.
sentences.zh: 所以他认为他会得到增援，他们随时会到达。

sentences.en: Are the Spanish going to think of Atoalpa as a usurper?
sentences.zh: 西班牙人会认为阿塔瓦尔帕是篡位者吗？

sentences.en: So does that invalidate him as someone with whom they can negotiate?
sentences.zh: 这是否会使他失去作为谈判对象的资格？

sentences.en: No, I don't think so straight away.
sentences.zh: 不，我不认为他们会立刻这么想。

sentences.en: But I think the further they get, the more they realise the divisions of the civil wars are a wonderful, wonderful opportunity for them.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们走得越远，就越意识到内战的分裂对他们来说是一个绝佳的、绝佳的机会。

sentences.en: Initially, they think of Atoalpa as a potential collaborator.
sentences.zh: 最初，他们把阿塔瓦尔帕视为潜在的合作者。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's what they want, really.
sentences.zh: 是的，那才是他们真正想要的。

sentences.en: That's what all empires want.
sentences.zh: 那是所有帝国想要的。

sentences.en: They don't want to fight unnecessarily.
sentences.zh: 他们不想进行不必要的战斗。

sentences.en: They may have to, but ideally, everyone will collaborate with them.
sentences.zh: 他们可能不得不打，但理想情况下，每个人都会与他们合作。

sentences.en: And in fact, the Spanish will find plenty of people who collaborate with them in the Inca empire, as they did with the Aztecs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，西班牙人会在印加帝国找到很多与他们合作的人，就像他们在阿兹特克帝国所做的那样。

sentences.en: It's kind of opportunistic militarism then, is basically their mood.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上是一种机会主义的军国主义心态。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's the right way of putting it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这样说很准确。

sentences.en: So Pizarro moves out on the 24th of September with his men.
sentences.zh: 所以皮萨罗在9月24日带着他的手下出发了。

sentences.en: He's left some men behind to found this new town, San Miguel de Tangarada.
sentences.zh: 他留下了一些人去建立这个新城镇，圣米格尔·德·坦加拉拉（San Miguel de Tangarada）。

sentences.en: And what that means is that he now has, what is it, 167 men plus him.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他现在有，是多少来着，167人加上他自己。

sentences.en: So 61 horsemen, 106 infantry.
sentences.zh: 也就是61名骑兵，106名步兵。

sentences.en: And there's a brilliant book of historical detective work called
sentences.zh: 有一本精彩的历史侦探著作叫

sentences.en: The Men of Cayamaca by James Lockhart, American historian, made in about 1970, where he really dug into where they were all from and what they all did.
sentences.zh: 《卡哈马卡的人们》（The Men of Cayamaca），由美国历史学家詹姆斯·洛克哈特（James Lockhart）在1970年左右创作，他深入挖掘了这些人来自哪里以及他们都做了什么。

sentences.en: Most of them are from the poorer, more rural, western and southern parts of Spain.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数来自西班牙较贫穷、较偏远的西部和南部地区。

sentences.en: So Extremadura, Andalusia and so on.
sentences.zh: 比如埃斯特雷马杜拉、安达卢西亚等等。

sentences.en: They're quite young, by and large.
sentences.zh: 他们大体上都很年轻。

sentences.en: They're in their 20s.
sentences.zh: 他们才20多岁。

sentences.en: The more senior people are in their early 30s.
sentences.zh: 资历较深的人也才30出头。

sentences.en: So Pizarro, he's unusually old then.
sentences.zh: 所以皮萨罗，他当时算是异常年长了。

sentences.en: He's a real outlier.
sentences.zh: 他确实是个异类。

sentences.en: He's about 52, I would say.
sentences.zh: 我想他大概52岁左右。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These are not trained soldiers, by and large.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，他们并非训练有素的士兵。

sentences.en: There's loads of accountants, tailors, merchants, craftsmen.
sentences.zh: 里面有大量的会计、裁缝、商人和工匠。

sentences.en: There's a barber.
sentences.zh: 还有个理发师。

sentences.en: There's a stonemason.
sentences.zh: 还有个石匠。

sentences.en: These are people who basically were, they weren't the poorest of the poor.
sentences.zh: 这些人基本上……他们并非穷困潦倒之辈。

sentences.en: They were artisans, I guess, who have decided to, you know, seek a new life and a new fortune.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是些工匠，决定去寻求新的生活和财富。

sentences.en: There are some out there.
sentences.zh: 外面确实有一些人。

sentences.en: There's the Cretan guy, the artillery man.
sentences.zh: 比如那个克里特人，是个炮兵。

sentences.en: So it's good to have him on the scene.
sentences.zh: 所以有他在场是件好事。

sentences.en: He's come with Pizarro and some guns.
sentences.zh: 他是随皮萨罗一起来的，还带了一些火炮。

sentences.en: And Pizarro's brother, Hernando, who fought in Italy.
sentences.zh: 还有皮萨罗的兄弟埃尔南多，他在意大利打过仗。

sentences.en: So there's a couple of people with military experience.
sentences.zh: 所以队伍里有几个有军事经验的人。

sentences.en: And a lot of these people will have seen action in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 而且这些人中有很多在加勒比地区见过战阵。

sentences.en: And that involved basically killing defenseless indigenous people, natives.
sentences.zh: 那所谓的“战阵”基本上就是屠杀手无寸铁的土著居民。

sentences.en: That's the action that they're used to.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们习惯的“战斗”。

sentences.en: They're not, you know, trained professional soldiers by any means.
sentences.zh: 他们绝不是什么训练有素的职业军人。

sentences.en: And why are they here?
sentences.zh: 那他们为什么会在这里？

sentences.en: They are here really for money.
sentences.zh: 他们来这里纯粹是为了钱。

sentences.en: Some of them are there for adventure.
sentences.zh: 有些人是为了冒险。

sentences.en: Some of them may be there for crusading zeal.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能是出于十字军式的狂热。

sentences.en: You know, the Dominicans, for example, there are five or six Dominicans who are with them.
sentences.zh: 比如多明我会修士，随行的就有五六个。

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: Dr. Valverde among them.
sentences.zh: 其中就有瓦尔韦德博士。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But there's a transactional element.
sentences.zh: 但其中也有交易的成分。

sentences.en: When they've got their gold, they either settle down with a farm in Peru, or a lot of them will go back to Spain.
sentences.zh: 等他们拿到黄金，要么就在秘鲁买地定居，要么就回西班牙。

sentences.en: That's the plan.
sentences.zh: 这就是计划。

sentences.en: So anyway, they set off 24th of September.
sentences.zh: 总之，他们在9月24日出发了。

sentences.en: It's a gruelling, gruelling trudge.
sentences.zh: 那是一段极其艰苦、极其漫长的跋涉。

sentences.en: So as one account puts it, there was much sun, little shade, much sand, and no water.
sentences.zh: 正如一份记录所言，那里阳光强烈，几乎没有树荫，到处是沙子，而且没有水。

sentences.en: Because this part of Peru is a kind of coastal desert plain.
sentences.zh: 因为秘鲁的这一带属于沿海沙漠平原。

sentences.en: So they're making good time, about 14 miles a day.
sentences.zh: 所以他们行进速度不错，每天大约走14英里。

sentences.en: They're absolutely fascinated by what they see.
sentences.zh: 他们对所见的一切感到无比着迷。

sentences.en: I mean, they write these fantastic accounts, the temples, the llamas, the very well ordered roads and bridges, the storehouses of food by the roadside.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们写下了精彩的记录：神庙、羊驼、秩序井然的道路和桥梁，还有路边堆满食物的仓库。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a very good sign as far as they're concerned.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，这绝对是个好兆头。

sentences.en: Because that means there is a lot of order and civilization, if there are sort of well-maintained storehouses.
sentences.zh: 因为这意味着如果仓库维护得这么好，说明当地有很高的秩序和文明程度。

sentences.en: Do they note with surprise the lack of wheels?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有惊讶于当地没有轮子？

sentences.en: I think it becomes obvious why there's no wheels, because there are no horses.
sentences.zh: 我想原因显而易见，因为那里没有马。

sentences.en: And whenever they go, people shy away from the horses and are absolutely astonished and horrified.
sentences.zh: 每当他们经过，当地人都会躲避马匹，表现得极其震惊和恐惧。

sentences.en: A horse is a very frightening thing, I think, if you've never seen a horse.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果你从未见过马，那确实是一种非常可怕的生物。

sentences.en: And we know throughout the Americas, when the Spanish turned up with horses, people were
sentences.zh: 我们知道在整个美洲，当西班牙人带着马出现时，人们都

sentences.en: absolutely stupefied and amazed and frightened.
sentences.zh: 感到无比惊愕、诧异和恐惧。

sentences.en: So they're beginning to attract attention.
sentences.zh: 所以他们开始引起注意了。

sentences.en: At one point, a messenger hails them on the road, and he says, I have been sent by
sentences.zh: 有一次，一名信使在路上拦住他们，说：我是受

sentences.en: Huascar, the defeated brother, by his faction, at leaSt. He has heard that you have come to bring justice to Peru, and he wants to ask for your protection.
sentences.zh: 瓦斯卡尔——那位战败的兄弟，或者至少是他的派系——之托而来。他听说你们来到秘鲁是为了伸张正义，他想请求你们的保护。

sentences.en: And Pizarro gives him a kind of non-committal answer.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗给了他一个模棱两可的回答。

sentences.en: He says, where there's injustice, we'll put it right.
sentences.zh: 他说，哪里有不公，我们就会去纠正。

sentences.en: But nothing more than that.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: There's also a very weird incident quite early on, when the Spanish notice a kind of young man hanging around their camp and lurking generally.
sentences.zh: 早期还发生了一件非常奇怪的事，西班牙人注意到有个年轻人总在营地附近徘徊，鬼鬼祟祟的。

sentences.en: And he's dressed as a sort of street peddler, and he has this huge shawl that he wears over his head and shoulders to protect him from the sun.
sentences.zh: 他打扮得像个街头小贩，头上和肩上披着一条巨大的披肩，用来遮挡阳光。

sentences.en: And he's always trying to get him to buy his trinkets.
sentences.zh: 他总是试图让人买他的小玩意儿。

sentences.en: And they call him Apu.
sentences.zh: 他们叫他阿普。

sentences.en: Apu is very interested in their horses and their swords.
sentences.zh: 阿普对他们的马和剑非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: And actually, it turns out that Apu is a spy sent by Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 事实上，后来发现阿普是阿塔瓦尔帕派来的间谍。

sentences.en: So not a very good one.
sentences.zh: 看来他干得不怎么样。

sentences.en: Not a terribly good one, no.
sentences.zh: 确实不怎么样，没错。

sentences.en: Now, I mentioned Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 刚才我提到了阿塔瓦尔帕。

sentences.en: What's he up to?
sentences.zh: 他在忙什么？

sentences.en: The emperor.
sentences.zh: 那位皇帝。

sentences.en: Or at least the would-be emperor he's been fighting his brother.
sentences.zh: 或者至少是准皇帝，他一直在和兄弟交战。

sentences.en: He has made camp about 300 miles away in the mountains near the town of Cayamaca.
sentences.zh: 他在距离这里约300英里外的山区，靠近卡哈马卡镇的地方扎了营。

sentences.en: His priority is not the Spanish.
sentences.zh: 他的首要任务不是西班牙人。

sentences.en: It is the civil war.
sentences.zh: 而是内战。

sentences.en: So he's waiting for news from the south, where his commander, who has the excellent name of Qiskis, is leading the final assault on Cuzco.
sentences.zh: 所以他在等南方的消息，他的指挥官——名字叫基斯基斯，这名字起得真好——正在那里对库斯科发动最后的进攻。

sentences.en: So when he gets news that a load of blokes with beards have turned up on the coast, they've been looting villages, they've been behaving poorly in storehouses, helping
sentences.zh: 所以当他收到消息说，一群留着胡子的家伙出现在海岸上，抢劫村庄，在仓库里行为不端，随意

sentences.en: themselves to the food.
sentences.zh: 拿走食物时。

sentences.en: They've been very rude to some of the locals.
sentences.zh: 他们对当地人非常粗鲁。

sentences.en: He's perturbed, you know, what's all this?
sentences.zh: 他感到不安，心想：这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: But he's not especially frightened.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有特别害怕。

sentences.en: Apu reports back and says the Spanish are in absolute shambles, actually.
sentences.zh: 阿普回去报告说，西班牙人简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: He says they're kind of villains, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 他说他们就是些恶棍，对吧？

sentences.en: Kind of indigents and robbers.
sentences.zh: 一群流浪汉和强盗。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是如此。

sentences.en: He says they're just an absolute bunch of rogues.
sentences.zh: 他说他们就是一群彻头彻尾的无赖。

sentences.en: Apu actually says, I think we should let them come, kill them all, except for three, because three of them are worth something.
sentences.zh: 阿普甚至说：我觉得我们应该让他们过来，把他们全杀了，只留三个，因为这三个人还有点用。

sentences.en: They've got a blacksmith who makes swords, amazing swords.
sentences.zh: 他们有个铁匠，能打造出惊人的宝剑。

sentences.en: We should keep him.
sentences.zh: 我们应该留下他。

sentences.en: We should keep the guy who's the horse, Tamer, because he can control these incredible beasts.
sentences.zh: 我们应该留下那个驯马师，因为他能控制这些不可思议的野兽。

sentences.en: And quite sweetly, he says we should keep the barber because he makes men look young again.
sentences.zh: 还有，他很可爱地说我们应该留下那个理发师，因为他能让人看起来变年轻。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 真不错。

sentences.en: By shaving them?
sentences.zh: 通过刮胡子吗？

sentences.en: By shaving them, presumably.
sentences.zh: 大概是通过刮胡子吧。

sentences.en: So there are people in Peru who do have beards?
sentences.zh: 所以秘鲁当地人也有胡子吗？

sentences.en: I guess so.
sentences.zh: 我想是吧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I was thinking about this.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想这个问题。

sentences.en: Surely Andeans are clean shaven, surely.
sentences.zh: 安第斯人肯定是不留胡子的，肯定的。

sentences.en: Relatively clean shaven.
sentences.zh: 相对来说不留胡子。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I mean, because the whole stuff about bearded men coming.
sentences.zh: 但我是说，关于“留胡子的人来了”的传言。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是如此。

sentences.en: It's important, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这很重要，不是吗？

sentences.en: I suppose a Spanish beard is larger and bulkier than an Andean beard.
sentences.zh: 我想西班牙人的胡子比安第斯人的胡子更浓密、更厚实。

sentences.en: An Andean beard?
sentences.zh: 安第斯人的胡子？

sentences.en: You never really would see an Andean beard, particularly, would you?
sentences.zh: 你从来没见过安第斯人留胡子，对吧？

sentences.en: It's always about beards, isn't it, in history?
sentences.zh: 历史上总是离不开胡子，不是吗？

sentences.en: Anyway, Atualp is intrigued by all this, and he sends one of his senior officers called
sentences.zh: 总之，阿塔瓦尔帕对这一切很感兴趣，他派了一名高级军官，名叫

sentences.en: Sikinchara to investigate.
sentences.zh: 西金查拉去调查。

sentences.en: Confusingly, some chronicles say Sikinchara is the same person as Apu, and some chronicles say he isn't.
sentences.zh: 令人困惑的是，有些编年史说西金查拉就是阿普，而有些则说不是。

sentences.en: So listeners can decide for themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以听众可以自己判断。

sentences.en: It's the rich unknowability of history, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这就是历史那迷人的不可知性，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, of the paSt. Sikinchara, whether he's Apu or not, he arrives at this provincial capital called Kachas on the 10th of October, and he finds that Hernando de Soto, the dashing
sentences.zh: 是的，关于过去。西金查拉，不管他是不是阿普，他在10月10日抵达了一个叫卡查斯的省会城市，发现埃尔南多·德·索托——那位风度翩翩的

sentences.en: horseman, has already arrived with a scouting party.
sentences.zh: 骑兵——已经带着一支侦察队到了。

sentences.en: And who have we here?
sentences.zh: 我们在这儿见到了谁？

sentences.en: Now, unfortunately, Sosoto is behaving very poorly.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，索托的表现非常恶劣。

sentences.en: So, Kachas, this place, has a college attached to its sun temple, and the college houses 500 ayayas, which are young women from
sentences.zh: 卡查斯这个地方，它的太阳神庙附设有一所学院，学院里住着500名“阿亚”，也就是来自

sentences.en: noble families who've been chosen for their bloodline or their beauty.
sentences.zh: 贵族家庭的年轻女性，她们因血统或美貌而被选中。

sentences.en: And basically, they will spend four years weaving cloth and brewing beer for the emperor.
sentences.zh: 基本上，她们要在那里待上四年，为皇帝织布和酿酒。

sentences.en: They're sort of virgins of the temple, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想她们算是神庙的处女吧。

sentences.en: Vestal virgin equivalents.
sentences.zh: 相当于维斯塔贞女。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Soto and his men have dragged them out into the square and are busy divvying them up among themselves.
sentences.zh: 索托和他的手下把她们拖到广场上，正忙着瓜分她们。

sentences.en: Sikinchara is appalled when he sees this, but obviously, he can't really do anything about it, because he can't match the Spanish muscle.
sentences.zh: 西金查拉看到这一幕感到震惊，但显然他无能为力，因为他无法抗衡西班牙人的武力。

sentences.en: He introduces himself to Soto.
sentences.zh: 他向索托做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: Soto says, great, when we're finished with these women, I'll take you back to Pizarro, which he does.
sentences.zh: 索托说：太好了，等我们处理完这些女人，我就带你去见皮萨罗。他也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: They go back to Pizarro's camp.
sentences.zh: 他们回到了皮萨罗的营地。

sentences.en: Sikinchara is very cool, actually.
sentences.zh: 西金查拉表现得非常冷静。

sentences.en: And we're told he entered as casually as if he'd been brought up all his life among Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 据说他进入营地时神态自若，就像从小在西班牙人中间长大一样。

sentences.en: This is because, of course, he's on home territory.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是因为他在自己的地盘上。

sentences.en: And he's used to, he's an important person.
sentences.zh: 而且他习惯了，他是个重要人物。

sentences.en: He's used to being treated with respect.
sentences.zh: 他习惯了受到尊重。

sentences.en: This leads me to believe, by the way, that he's not Apu.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这让我相信他不是阿普。

sentences.en: Because if you'd been hanging around in a shawl pretending to sell trinkets, and then you return, you would look shamefaced, I think.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你披着披肩假装卖小玩意儿，然后又回来，我想你会感到羞愧的。

sentences.en: But I mean, not to do him down.
sentences.zh: 我不是要贬低他。

sentences.en: I mean, he's obviously a very, very cool customer.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他显然是个非常、非常冷静的人。

sentences.en: You have to have incredible courage to turn up and confront these terrible men.
sentences.zh: 你必须有惊人的勇气才能挺身而出，去面对这些可怕的人。

sentences.en: He's brought them some nice gifts, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，他确实带了一些精美的礼物。

sentences.en: He's brought them two pots that are shaped as forts, weirdly, and some skinned ducks.
sentences.zh: 他带了两个形状像堡垒的罐子，真奇怪，还有一些剥了皮的鸭子。

sentences.en: And the Spanish take the gifts.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人收下了礼物。

sentences.en: And it's amusing, actually.
sentences.zh: 这其实挺好笑的。

sentences.en: The Spanish are convinced they must have some secret meaning or overthinking.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人坚信这些东西一定有什么秘密含义，想得太多了。

sentences.en: So they're kind of staring at the pot.
sentences.zh: 所以他们盯着罐子看。

sentences.en: They're massively overthinking it.
sentences.zh: 他们想得太多了。

sentences.en: They're like, do the pots mean there are a lot of castles?
sentences.zh: 他们心想：这些罐子是不是意味着有很多城堡？

sentences.en: And what about the ducks?
sentences.zh: 那鸭子又是什么意思？

sentences.en: They will skin us alive.
sentences.zh: 他们会把我们活剥了。

sentences.en: That's what the Spanish say.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人就是这么说的。

sentences.en: They think that they're going to be skinned alive like the ducks.
sentences.zh: 他们认为自己会像那些鸭子一样被活剥。

sentences.en: Actually, I think he's just given them something to eat.
sentences.zh: 其实我觉得他只是给他们带了点吃的。

sentences.en: Anyway,
sentences.zh: 总之，

sentences.en: Sikin Chara spends two days in the camp.
sentences.zh: 西金查拉在营地待了两天。

sentences.en: He makes a note of everything.
sentences.zh: 他把一切都记了下来。

sentences.en: And finally, he says to Pizarro, listen, the emperor would like you to continue to
sentences.zh: 最后，他对皮萨罗说：听着，皇帝希望你们继续前往

sentences.en: Kayamarka, and he will greet you personally.
sentences.zh: 卡哈马卡，他会亲自迎接你们。

sentences.en: And Pizarro's like, brilliant, this is what he wants.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗心想：太棒了，这就是他想要的。

sentences.en: So he sends Sikin Chara back.
sentences.zh: 于是他把西金查拉送了回去。

sentences.en: He says, here's a lovely gift for you and for the emperor.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是一份送给你和皇帝的精美礼物。

sentences.en: A nice linen shirt.
sentences.zh: 一件漂亮的亚麻衬衫。

sentences.en: We've got two glass goblets from Venice, and some scissors, scissors, and some combs, and a mirror.
sentences.zh: 我们有两只来自威尼斯的玻璃高脚杯，还有一些剪刀、剪刀，以及一些梳子和一面镜子。

sentences.en: So back they go with the gifts.
sentences.zh: 于是他们带着礼物回去了。

sentences.en: Now, important to say at this point, some people may be listening to this and thinking, do the Incas believe that the Spaniards are gods?
sentences.zh: 现在，在这一点上必须说明的是，有些人听了可能会想，印加人是否认为西班牙人是神？

sentences.en: Which is a thing you often hear as you do about the conquest of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 这在谈论墨西哥征服史时经常听到。

sentences.en: There was absolutely no evidence for this whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 这完全没有任何证据支持。

sentences.en: The Incas definitely didn't think they were gods.
sentences.zh: 印加人绝对不认为他们是神。

sentences.en: But they thought they might be, I mean, some Incas seem to have thought they might be messengers of the gods.
sentences.zh: 但他们可能认为，我是说，一些印加人似乎认为他们可能是神的信使。

sentences.en: So the Viracocha, the creator god, they call them, these are Viracochas.
sentences.zh: 所以他们称之为维拉科查，即造物主，这些人就是维拉科查。

sentences.en: Yeah, Viracocha's messengers or sons of Viracocha, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，维拉科查的信使或维拉科查之子，正是如此。

sentences.en: And there is that kind of Quetzalcoatl stuff that you have in Mexico with the idea of bearded men coming from the sea and that these are Viracocha's.
sentences.zh: 而且在墨西哥也有那种关于魁扎尔科亚特尔的传说，即留着胡子的男人从海上而来，而这些人就是维拉科查。

sentences.en: I'm not sure about that, Tom.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，对此我不太确定。

sentences.en: I don't agree with that.
sentences.zh: 我不同意这一点。

sentences.en: I think for a couple of reasons.
sentences.zh: 我认为有几个原因。

sentences.en: First of all, I think people end up, even in the 16th century, conflating the two conquests and taking
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为人们最终，即使是在16世纪，也会将这两次征服混为一谈，并把

sentences.en: details from one and putting them in the other as the stories are repeated and written down by other chroniclers, by basically that classic thing that historians do.
sentences.zh: 一个事件的细节放到另一个事件中，因为故事被其他编年史家反复讲述和记录，基本上就是历史学家常做的那种经典行为。

sentences.en: The myths are repeated in secondary histories, and then people stop questioning them.
sentences.zh: 神话在二手历史中被反复引用，然后人们就不再质疑它们了。

sentences.en: But the thing about are they are the sons of Viracocha or the messengers of Viracocha or whatever.
sentences.zh: 但关于他们是否是维拉科查之子或维拉科查的信使之类的问题。

sentences.en: This is almost certainly either a literary formula or it's a courtesy.
sentences.zh: 这几乎可以肯定要么是一种文学套路，要么是一种客套话。

sentences.en: I don't think people think they are literally sent by the gods because the way the Incas behave towards them is exactly as they would behave if
sentences.zh: 我不认为人们真的认为他们是神派来的，因为印加人对待他们的方式，与对待

sentences.en: they thought there were other human beings like themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们认为是和自己一样的人类的方式完全相同。

sentences.en: Yeah, accepted.
sentences.zh: 是的，接受这个观点。

sentences.en: But just to kind of slightly push on this, the Incas are living among chaos.
sentences.zh: 但稍微深入探讨一下，印加人正生活在混乱之中。

sentences.en: Their empire is being swept by plague.
sentences.zh: 他们的帝国正遭受瘟疫的席卷。

sentences.en: There is this terrible civil war.
sentences.zh: 还有那场可怕的内战。

sentences.en: And now these peculiar people with mad animals have turned up.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些带着疯狂动物的奇特人出现了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Is there a sense of the kind of the Incan cosmology of different ages of cycles of time?
sentences.zh: 印加宇宙观中是否存在关于不同时代或时间循环的概念？

sentences.en: And might this be presaging a new cycle of time?
sentences.zh: 这是否预示着一个新的时间循环？

sentences.en: A kind of apocalyptic sense?
sentences.zh: 一种末日感？

sentences.en: I think there is.
sentences.zh: 我想是有的。

sentences.en: I mean, there's definitely apocalyptic there.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那里绝对有末日论的成分。

sentences.en: There's definitely a strain.
sentences.zh: 绝对存在这种倾向。

sentences.en: There were stories of the end of the world and things like that.
sentences.zh: 当时确实有关于世界末日之类的故事。

sentences.en: But you don't get a massive sense that people think this is the end of days.
sentences.zh: 但你不会感觉到人们普遍认为这就是世界末日。

sentences.en: These people are the heralds of some terrible doom, all of this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 这些人是某种可怕厄运的先驱，诸如此类。

sentences.en: I think actually most people are making much more pragmatic political considerations.
sentences.zh: 我认为实际上大多数人是在做更务实的政治考量。

sentences.en: I mean, you can do both, can't you?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你可以两者兼顾，不是吗？

sentences.en: Rather than apocalyptic or eschatological ones.
sentences.zh: 而不是末日论或终极论的考量。

sentences.en: There's no, we don't have really that much evidence of people thinking in apocalyptic terms about the coming of the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 我们确实没有太多证据表明人们以末日论的角度看待西班牙人的到来。

sentences.en: But we do have evidence about them making kind of Machiavellian calculations about what they can do with this new variable of 168 people with the horses in particular.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实有证据表明他们正在进行某种马基雅维利式的算计，思考如何利用这168人，尤其是那些马匹这一新变量。

sentences.en: I think that's what Atahualpa is doing, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我认为阿塔瓦尔帕就是在做这件事。

sentences.en: I think Atahualpa is sitting there in Chiarmarca.
sentences.zh: 我认为阿塔瓦尔帕正坐在卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: He's thinking about the civil war.
sentences.zh: 他在考虑内战。

sentences.en: All the evidence actually for the next year or so is that that's pretty much all Atahualpa is thinking about is the civil war.
sentences.zh: 事实上，接下来一年左右的所有证据都表明，阿塔瓦尔帕想的几乎全是内战。

sentences.en: I think he thinks these will be excellent mercenaries.
sentences.zh: 我想他认为这些人会是出色的雇佣兵。

sentences.en: Or, if he can kill them, get their horses, get the guy who can make the swords for him.
sentences.zh: 或者，如果他能杀了他们，夺取他们的马匹，抓住那个能为他制造剑的人。

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: You know, it's literally a cutting edge, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这确实是尖端技术，不是吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: I think their military technology really interests him.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们的军事技术确实让他很感兴趣。

sentences.en: And he thinks, brilliant, I can use this to finish off Huascar's faction, complete my victory in the civil war.
sentences.zh: 他想，太棒了，我可以利用这一点来消灭瓦斯卡尔的派系，完成我在内战中的胜利。

sentences.en: There's no reason for him to think this is an existential threat.
sentences.zh: 他没有理由认为这是一种生存威胁。

sentences.en: The Spaniards, of course, know what happened in Mexico to Montezuma.
sentences.zh: 当然，西班牙人知道墨西哥发生的针对蒙特祖马的事。

sentences.en: He doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 但他不知道。

sentences.en: He's never heard of the Spaniards before.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未听说过西班牙人。

sentences.en: I mean, even at this stage, they are maybe thinking a decapitation strategy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，即使在这个阶段，他们可能也在考虑斩首策略。

sentences.en: You capture the top man, maybe some of his family, some of the elite, and then you leave the empire leaderless.
sentences.zh: 你俘虏了首领，也许还有他的一些家人、一些精英，然后让帝国群龙无首。

sentences.en: It worked for Hernán Cortés.
sentences.zh: 这对埃尔南·科尔特斯很有效。

sentences.en: It worked for your cousin, Francisco.
sentences.zh: 这对你的表亲弗朗西斯科也很有效。

sentences.en: Maybe it'll work for you.
sentences.zh: 也许这对你也有效。

sentences.en: I guess that kind of capturing leading people is in the DNA of the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 我想那种俘虏领导人的做法已经融入了西班牙人的基因里。

sentences.en: I mean, it's in the DNA of all Christians.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这融入了所有基督徒的基因里。

sentences.en: I mean, all that 100 years war stuff.
sentences.zh: 我是说，所有那些百年战争的事情。

sentences.en: Capturing people and using that to get money is what European soldiers do.
sentences.zh: 俘虏人并以此勒索钱财是欧洲士兵的做法。

sentences.en: Isn't it 1527?
sentences.zh: 不是1527年吗？

sentences.en: They invaded the Rome, sacked Rome, took the Pope prisoner.
sentences.zh: 他们入侵了罗马，洗劫了罗马，俘虏了教皇。

sentences.en: Thereby causing the English Reformation.
sentences.zh: 从而引发了英国宗教改革。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So the Spanish are coming closer and closer, just as old Martin describes in that reading from the play.
sentences.zh: 所以西班牙人越来越近了，就像老马丁在剧本朗读中所描述的那样。

sentences.en: They turn inland from the Pacific and they go up into the Andes.
sentences.zh: 他们从太平洋转向内陆，进入安第斯山脉。

sentences.en: They go up through this valley, through the cotton fields, into the canyons.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过这个山谷，穿过棉花田，进入峡谷。

sentences.en: They're now about 13,000 feet above sea level.
sentences.zh: 他们现在海拔约13000英尺。

sentences.en: So they're breathless.
sentences.zh: 所以他们气喘吁吁。

sentences.en: They're cold.
sentences.zh: 他们很冷。

sentences.en: It's absolutely freezing.
sentences.zh: 简直冷得要命。

sentences.en: There's no shelter.
sentences.zh: 没有遮蔽处。

sentences.en: They're very, very anxious because they can see people watching them the whole time from kind of watchtowers.
sentences.zh: 他们非常非常焦虑，因为他们能看到人们一直从某种瞭望塔上盯着他们。

sentences.en: I cannot imagine doing it.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象那种经历。

sentences.en: It's crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It just seems insane behavior.
sentences.zh: 这看起来简直是疯狂的行为。

sentences.en: Hernando Pizarro said, you know, they could have finished us off at any time.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多·皮萨罗说，你知道，他们本可以在任何时候消灭我们。

sentences.en: We couldn't use the horses on the mountain roads.
sentences.zh: 我们在山路上无法使用马匹。

sentences.en: Off the roads, we could take neither horses nor foot soldiers.
sentences.zh: 离开道路，我们既不能带马也不能带步兵。

sentences.en: We were completely vulnerable, snaking along these kind of mountain passes.
sentences.zh: 我们完全处于脆弱状态，沿着这些山路蜿蜒前行。

sentences.en: And the Incubs are watching us, but they're not acting.
sentences.zh: 印加人看着我们，但他们没有采取行动。

sentences.en: And actually, we know from what we get a sense from later chronicles and things, that some of Atahualpa's counselors said, why are you letting these people come?
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们从后来的编年史中了解到，阿塔瓦尔帕的一些顾问曾说，你为什么要让这些人过来？

sentences.en: Why not just strike now and kill them all?
sentences.zh: 为什么不现在就出击把他们全杀了？

sentences.en: And Atahualpa says to them, it is folly to be so concerned about 170 men.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕对他们说，为170个人如此担忧是愚蠢的。

sentences.en: Let's find out who they are.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看他们是谁。

sentences.en: What have we got to lose?
sentences.zh: 我们有什么可损失的？

sentences.en: Let them keep coming.
sentences.zh: 让他们继续过来吧。

sentences.en: He really wants to see the horses.
sentences.zh: 他真的很想看看马匹。

sentences.en: He wants to see these guys who have strange weapons that make an explosion and everyone runs away, arquebuses and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他想看看这些家伙，他们有奇怪的武器，能发出爆炸声，让所有人都逃跑，比如火绳枪之类的东西。

sentences.en: And it's a bit different from Montezuma.
sentences.zh: 这和蒙特祖马的情况有点不同。

sentences.en: Montezuma was in his capital, in the palace.
sentences.zh: 蒙特祖马在他的首都，在宫殿里。

sentences.en: Atahualpa is with his army.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕和他的军队在一起。

sentences.en: He's in a military camp with 80,000 men.
sentences.zh: 他在一个拥有8万人的军营里。

sentences.en: Why would he be frightened about fewer than 200 men?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要害怕不到200个人？

sentences.en: And he's just won a very bloody civil war.
sentences.zh: 而且他刚刚赢得了一场非常血腥的内战。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I mean, no one can be in any doubt that he's ready to crush his enemies if he has to.
sentences.zh: 我是说，没有人会怀疑他如果必须的话，已经准备好粉碎他的敌人了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: On the 9th of November, they get another messenger from Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 11月9日，他们又收到了阿塔瓦尔帕的一名信使。

sentences.en: The messenger brings them 10 llamas as a gift.
sentences.zh: 信使给他们带来了10头美洲驼作为礼物。

sentences.en: And he says, the emperor is at the hot springs near Kayamarka, outside Kayamarka.
sentences.zh: 他说，皇帝在卡哈马卡附近的温泉，在卡哈马卡城外。

sentences.en: They're five days' march away.
sentences.zh: 他们还有五天的路程。

sentences.en: He's looking forward to seeing you.
sentences.zh: 他很期待见到你们。

sentences.en: They make slow progress.
sentences.zh: 他们进展缓慢。

sentences.en: And five days later, they reach the last village before the valley of Kayamarka, which is called Zavanna.
sentences.zh: 五天后，他们到达了卡哈马卡山谷前的最后一个村庄，名叫扎瓦纳。

sentences.en: They've now been on the road for 52 days, six months in total since they left the coast because they've dallied at firSt.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在路上走了52天，从离开海岸算起总共六个月，因为他们起初耽搁了。

sentences.en: Another messenger brings them food from Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 另一名信使给他们带来了阿塔瓦尔帕送来的食物。

sentences.en: He says, he can't wait.
sentences.zh: 他说，他等不及了。

sentences.en: Looking forward to seeing you.
sentences.zh: 期待见到你们。

sentences.en: And Pizarro says to his men, right, get ready for battle now.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗对他的手下说，好了，现在准备战斗。

sentences.en: We're pretty close.
sentences.zh: 我们离得很近了。

sentences.en: So that's the 14th.
sentences.zh: 所以那是14号。

sentences.en: The next day is the 15th.
sentences.zh: 第二天是15号。

sentences.en: The path rises for the last time in the mountains, and they reach the highest point at around midday.
sentences.zh: 道路最后一次在山中上升，他们在中午左右到达了最高点。

sentences.en: And they look down and they see the valley of Kayamarka.
sentences.zh: 他们向下望去，看到了卡哈马卡山谷。

sentences.en: It's only a few miles wide.
sentences.zh: 它只有几英里宽。

sentences.en: It's very fertile, fields of cotton plantations.
sentences.zh: 土地非常肥沃，有棉花种植园。

sentences.en: They can see the stone buildings of the town glinting in the sunlight.
sentences.zh: 他们可以看到城镇的石头建筑在阳光下闪闪发光。

sentences.en: And then beyond that, four miles behind the town, they can see this, what looks like a sea of white shapes.
sentences.zh: 在那之外，城镇后方四英里处，他们可以看到这片看起来像白色海洋的东西。

sentences.en: And these are the 10ths of Atahualpa's army, tens of thousands strong.
sentences.zh: 这些是阿塔瓦尔帕军队的帐篷，有数万人之多。

sentences.en: So to quote one of the conquistadors, so many tents were visible that we were filled with great apprehension.
sentences.zh: 引用其中一位征服者的话说，可见的帐篷如此之多，以至于我们心中充满了极大的恐惧。

sentences.en: We never thought that
sentences.zh: 我们从没想过

sentences.en: Indians, his terminology in lock mine, could maintain such a proud estate, nor have so many tents in such good order.
sentences.zh: 印第安人（这是他当时的用词）能保持如此宏大的排场，也没有想到会有这么多井然有序的帐篷。

sentences.en: It filled all of us Spaniards with fear and confusion, but it was not appropriate to show any fear, far less to turn back.
sentences.zh: 这让我们所有西班牙人都感到恐惧和困惑，但表现出任何恐惧都是不合适的，更不用说回头了。

sentences.en: And so Pizarro says, come on then, let's do this.
sentences.zh: 于是皮萨罗说，来吧，我们干吧。

sentences.en: And they spur their horses and they begin to descend the path towards the town of Kayamarka.
sentences.zh: 他们策马扬鞭，开始沿着小路向卡哈马卡镇走去。

sentences.en: God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So they approach the wall of Kayamarka.
sentences.zh: 他们接近了卡哈马卡的城墙。

sentences.en: They go through the gate.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过大门。

sentences.en: Kayamarka today is a very kind of handsome Spanish colonial town.
sentences.zh: 今天的卡哈马卡是一个非常漂亮的西班牙殖民风格城镇。

sentences.en: At the time, it was an Inca town of about 2000 people.
sentences.zh: 当时，它是一个拥有约2000人的印加城镇。

sentences.en: And when they get there, there's hardly anybody there.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达那里时，几乎没有人。

sentences.en: The streets are deserted, quiet.
sentences.zh: 街道空荡荡的，很安静。

sentences.en: There are no people to be seen.
sentences.zh: 看不到人。

sentences.en: One Spanish memoirist said later, all we could hear was the ghostly keening of women, singing of the death that awaits the strangers who have provoked the wrath of the great Inca.
sentences.zh: 一位西班牙回忆录作者后来写道，我们所能听到的只有妇女们幽灵般的哀号，歌唱着等待那些激怒了伟大印加王愤怒的陌生人的死亡。

sentences.en: I mean, that's pretty terrifying.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那真是太可怕了。

sentences.en: So they press on, they go past a sun temple, they go past another of these convents, and they emerge into this main square of Kayamarka.
sentences.zh: 于是他们继续前进，经过一座太阳神庙，经过另一座修道院，然后进入了卡哈马卡的主广场。

sentences.en: Now, very important for people to get this into their heads.
sentences.zh: 现在，让人们记住这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: This square is surrounded on three sides by these kind of long, low stone buildings, which were basically, they're 200 yards long, and each of these buildings had
sentences.zh: 这个广场三面环绕着那种长而低的石头建筑，它们基本上有200码长，每一座建筑都有

sentences.en: about 20 doors in it.
sentences.zh: 大约20扇门。

sentences.en: And basically what they were, they were called Kalankas, and they were used as dormitories for people who came through the town to work in the kind of labor gangs, or in the army,
sentences.zh: 它们基本上被称为卡兰卡，被用作那些来到镇上从事劳役或在军队中服役的人的宿舍，

sentences.en: or even pilgrims arriving for a religious festival or something like that.
sentences.zh: 甚至包括为宗教节日等活动而来的朝圣者。

sentences.en: They're there surrounded by these long, low buildings in the middle of this square.
sentences.zh: 他们身处广场中央，四周环绕着那些低矮的长建筑。

sentences.en: And there's no one else there.
sentences.zh: 周围空无一人。

sentences.en: And it starts to rain.
sentences.zh: 这时开始下雨了。

sentences.en: And they say, well, let's go into these buildings, and they go and take shelter in the barracks.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧，我们进这些建筑里去吧，于是他们走过去，在营房里躲雨。

sentences.en: Dominic, also, can I just ask, in the middle of this square, there's a kind of a ceremonial platform, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我能问一下吗，广场中央是不是有一个类似礼仪台的东西？

sentences.en: So that's also going to play a part.
sentences.zh: 所以那也会起到一定作用。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Pizarro and his captains gather around, they have a little council of war, and they're all very nervous.
sentences.zh: 于是皮萨罗和他的队长们聚在一起，开了个小型的作战会议，他们都非常紧张。

sentences.en: You know, there's no one here, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这儿一个人都没有，到底怎么回事？

sentences.en: I mean, how could you not be nervous?
sentences.zh: 我是说，怎么可能不紧张呢？

sentences.en: Of course, I'm not knocking them.
sentences.zh: 当然，我不是在贬低他们。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a sound like you're judging them.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听起来好像你在评判他们一样。

sentences.en: I wouldn't be nervous.
sentences.zh: 换我我也不会紧张。

sentences.en: From the heart of the Cotswolds.
sentences.zh: 来自科茨沃尔德的中心地带。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: He sends his lieutenant, Hernando de Soto, he says, I want you to go over to Attawell, but go over to his camp, wherever he is.
sentences.zh: 他派出了副手埃尔南多·德·索托，他说，我要你去阿塔瓦尔帕那里，去他的营地，不管他在哪儿。

sentences.en: He's at these hot springs or whatever they are.
sentences.zh: 他在那些温泉还是什么地方。

sentences.en: Take 15 of your best horsemen.
sentences.zh: 带上你最好的15名骑兵。

sentences.en: Take one of the interpreters with you.
sentences.zh: 带上一名翻译。

sentences.en: The Spanish can't agree whether it's Felipe or Martinillo.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人对于到底是费利佩还是马丁尼略也争论不休。

sentences.en: I don't know they know the difference.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是否分得清。

sentences.en: Find out what he wants, what his plan is, you know, where does he want us to stay, all of this.
sentences.zh: 去弄清楚他想要什么，他的计划是什么，你知道，他想让我们待在哪里，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Soto goes off with the cavalry, 15 men.
sentences.zh: 索托带着骑兵队出发了，一共15人。

sentences.en: And Francisco goes for a walk with his brother, Hernando.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科则和他的兄弟埃尔南多去散步。

sentences.en: And Hernando goes with him and says, I think we made a mistake, actually.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多跟着他说，我觉得我们其实犯了个错误。

sentences.en: You've just sent our best horsemen off at Attawell, but there's only 15 of them.
sentences.zh: 你刚把我们最好的骑兵派去阿塔瓦尔帕那里，但只有15个人。

sentences.en: And if the Incas turn on them, you know, it's curtains for them.
sentences.zh: 如果印加人对他们动手，你知道，他们就死定了。

sentences.en: And Francisco says, yeah, you're right, actually.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科说，是啊，你说得对。

sentences.en: You go after them.
sentences.zh: 你去追他们。

sentences.en: Take 20 more men and go after them.
sentences.zh: 再带20个人去追上他们。

sentences.en: And Hernando does.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多照做了。

sentences.en: And that's very lucky for us and for everyone listening to this podcast, because among the men that Hernando takes are people who wrote books about it afterwards.
sentences.zh: 这对我们以及所有收听这个播客的人来说非常幸运，因为埃尔南多带去的人中，有些人后来写了关于这件事的书。

sentences.en: So there's a guy called Miguel de Estete, and there's a guy called Diego de Trujillo.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫米格尔·德·埃斯特特的人，还有一个叫迭戈·德·特鲁希略的人。

sentences.en: And they both wrote long eyewitness accounts for the meeting, which of course, in traditional Spanish conquistador fashion, disagree with each other on the details.
sentences.zh: 他们都写了关于这次会面的长篇目击记录，当然，按照西班牙征服者的一贯传统，他们在细节上各执一词。

sentences.en: But anyway, so Hernando is following Soto along the stone road, which goes out for four miles from the town to a place called Pultamarca.
sentences.zh: 总之，埃尔南多沿着石路追赶索托，这条路从镇上延伸出四英里，通往一个叫普尔塔马尔卡的地方。

sentences.en: Today, it's called Banyos del Inca, the baths of the Inca, which tells you what it was like.
sentences.zh: 今天那里被称为“印加浴场”，这名字就说明了它以前的样子。

sentences.en: It's basically a spring.
sentences.zh: 它基本上就是一个泉眼。

sentences.en: It's a spa.
sentences.zh: 一个温泉疗养地。

sentences.en: Attawell is taking the waters there.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕正在那里泡温泉。

sentences.en: And to get there, they have to go pass through Attawell's army, through all the tents.
sentences.zh: 要到达那里，他们必须穿过阿塔瓦尔帕的军队，穿过所有的帐篷。

sentences.en: And Estete, in his account, says, you know, we were absolutely terrified,
sentences.zh: 埃斯特特在记录中说，你知道，我们当时简直吓坏了，

sentences.en: advancing through these ranks and ranks of soldiers who are just staring at us in silence.
sentences.zh: 穿过那一排排沉默地盯着我们的士兵队伍。

sentences.en: But having to kind of convey a sense of cool and fortitude.
sentences.zh: 但还得表现出一种冷静和坚毅的样子。

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 是啊，当然。

sentences.en: Imagine, imagine.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，想象一下。

sentences.en: It's like the bit in Apocalypse Now when they arrive at
sentences.zh: 就像《现代启示录》里他们到达

sentences.en: Marlon Brando's camp.
sentences.zh: 马龙·白兰度营地的那一幕。

sentences.en: And all the tribesmen are just sort of staring at them silently.
sentences.zh: 所有的部落民都那样沉默地盯着他们。

sentences.en: It's like that.
sentences.zh: 就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: And finally, they get through the camp and there's Attawell's sort of palace building, his country house or whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们穿过了营地，看到了阿塔瓦尔帕的宫殿建筑，他的乡间别墅之类的东西。

sentences.en: There's a stone building with two towers and there's about 400 warriors guarding it.
sentences.zh: 那是一座有两座塔楼的石建筑，大约有400名战士守卫着它。

sentences.en: And all they can hear is the water bubbling in the pipes and pools of the hot springs, just this deathly silence.
sentences.zh: 他们只能听到温泉管道和水池里冒泡的声音，死一般的寂静。

sentences.en: And their interpreter says, we'd like to see the emperor.
sentences.zh: 他们的翻译说，我们想见皇帝。

sentences.en: And no one, you know, Attawell doesn't come out.
sentences.zh: 但没人出来，你知道，阿塔瓦尔帕没有出来。

sentences.en: And Hernando Pizarro, who's very hot tempered, starts shouting, tell that dog to come out.
sentences.zh: 脾气火爆的埃尔南多·皮萨罗开始大喊，叫那条狗出来。

sentences.en: God, it's lucky they didn't speak Spanish.
sentences.zh: 天哪，幸好他们听不懂西班牙语。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And eventually, a nobleman appears and it's their old mate, Sikinchara.
sentences.zh: 最终，一位贵族出现了，是他们的老熟人西金查拉。

sentences.en: And there's some form of interaction, very garbled actually.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了一些交流，其实非常含糊不清。

sentences.en: And eventually, the moment comes where they will see the emperor.
sentences.zh: 终于，他们见到皇帝的时刻到了。

sentences.en: Though what's unclear from the accounts is if they go in or Attawell comes out, I think they go in actually.
sentences.zh: 虽然记录中不清楚是他们进去还是阿塔瓦尔帕出来，我觉得其实是他们进去了。

sentences.en: Apu isn't around.
sentences.zh: 阿普不在附近。

sentences.en: Well, Apu may be Sikinchara.
sentences.zh: 嗯，阿普可能就是西金查拉。

sentences.en: This is the confusing thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是令人困惑的地方。

sentences.en: So why are all the accounts so garbled?
sentences.zh: 那为什么所有的记录都这么含糊不清呢？

sentences.en: This cuts to the confusion of the story.
sentences.zh: 这触及了这个故事的混乱本质。

sentences.en: The Spaniards themselves are very confused because they don't really know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人自己也非常困惑，因为他们根本不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: They don't speak a word of Quechua.
sentences.zh: 他们一句克丘亚语都不会说。

sentences.en: They're in this new land.
sentences.zh: 他们身处这片陌生的土地。

sentences.en: They might as well be on an alien planet.
sentences.zh: 他们简直就像是在外星球上一样。

sentences.en: Weird people, weird customs, all this.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的人，奇怪的习俗，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And their interpreters are useless.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的翻译毫无用处。

sentences.en: So whoever is there, either Felipio or Martinio, they stumble and stutter.
sentences.zh: 所以无论是在场的费利佩还是马丁尼略，他们都结结巴巴。

sentences.en: They must be frightened themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们自己肯定也很害怕。

sentences.en: They're stumbling and stuttering over their words.
sentences.zh: 他们说话时磕磕绊绊，语无伦次。

sentences.en: And actually, when they do talk to Attawell,
sentences.zh: 事实上，当他们和阿塔瓦尔帕交谈时，

sentences.en: Attawell at one point says of the interpreter, what does this fellow mean stammering from one word to another and from one mistake to the next as if he were dumb?
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕有一次指着翻译说，这个家伙结结巴巴，从一个词到另一个词，从一个错误到下一个错误，像个哑巴一样，他到底想说什么？

sentences.en: How do we know he said that?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么知道他说了这话？

sentences.en: Because the interpreter must have translated.
sentences.zh: 因为翻译肯定翻译出来了。

sentences.en: How can we trust the interpreter if they're useless?
sentences.zh: 如果翻译没用，我们怎么能相信他们？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's highly unlikely you'd make that up about yourself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得你不太可能编造这种关于自己的事。

sentences.en: Well, the emperor is saying that I'm a useless translator.
sentences.zh: 毕竟皇帝是在说我是一个没用的翻译。

sentences.en: You're not going to make that up.
sentences.zh: 你不会编造这种话的。

sentences.en: But anyway, throughout this story runs this thread of misunderstanding, possibly deliberate misinformation.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，这个故事始终贯穿着误解的线索，甚至可能是蓄意的错误信息。

sentences.en: In the Aztec story, listeners will recall that Malinche may well have been manipulating the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 在阿兹特克的故事里，听众们可能还记得，马林切很可能一直在操纵整件事。

sentences.en: And we just don't know about these interpreters, these boys, whether they were making stuff up or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道这些翻译，这些年轻人，他们是否在编造内容之类的。

sentences.en: Anyway, this is now the moment when they first lay eyes on the emperor.
sentences.zh: 总之，现在是他们第一次见到皇帝的时刻。

sentences.en: To quote one conquistador, he was seated on a small stool very low on the ground as the Turks and Moors are accustomed to sit, with all the majesty in the world, surrounded
sentences.zh: 引用一位征服者的话，他坐在地上一个很低的小凳子上，就像土耳其人和摩尔人习惯坐的那样，带着世间所有的威严，被

sentences.en: by all his women and with many chiefs near him.
sentences.zh: 他所有的妻妾环绕，身边还有许多酋长。

sentences.en: And they describe him probably in his early 30s.
sentences.zh: 他们描述他大概30出头。

sentences.en: He's got long black hair.
sentences.zh: 留着长长的黑发。

sentences.en: He wears his hair long because he's been injured in the civil war in the ear and he's covering that up.
sentences.zh: 他留长发是因为他在内战中耳朵受了伤，他在掩盖伤口。

sentences.en: Oh, that's bad if you're a big ear, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 哦，如果你耳朵很大，那可真糟糕，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I guess so.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是吧。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that's probably why he grows his hair.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能就是他留长发的原因。

sentences.en: He has a brightly colored cloak.
sentences.zh: 他披着一件色彩鲜艳的斗篷。

sentences.en: He's got this thing on his brow, which is the crown, the circlet of red wool threaded with gold and this kind of red tassel that hangs above his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他的额头上戴着东西，那是皇冠，一个用金线编织的红羊毛圆环，还有一种垂在眼前的红色流苏。

sentences.en: And this crown is called the mascapecha, which is the crown of the Sapa Inca.
sentences.zh: 这顶皇冠被称为“马斯卡佩查”，是萨帕·印卡的皇冠。

sentences.en: But he's sitting on the stool and he doesn't move.
sentences.zh: 但他坐在凳子上，一动不动。

sentences.en: He doesn't even look at them.
sentences.zh: 他甚至看都不看他们一眼。

sentences.en: And they advance closer.
sentences.zh: 他们走近了一些。

sentences.en: Strangely, they're still on horseback.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，他们仍然骑在马上。

sentences.en: I don't quite know how this works, whether he's come out or they've gone in, but they're still on their horses because we are told
sentences.zh: 我不太清楚这是怎么回事，是他出来了还是他们进去了，但他们还在马上，因为我们被告知

sentences.en: Soto's horse was so close to Atahualpa that the breath from its nostrils stirred the tassel.
sentences.zh: 索托的马离阿塔瓦尔帕非常近，马鼻孔喷出的气吹动了流苏。

sentences.en: But still, Atahualpa doesn't show a flicker of emotion.
sentences.zh: 但阿塔瓦尔帕依然没有流露出一丝情绪。

sentences.en: Well, that speaks very well of his courage, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很能说明他的勇气，不是吗？

sentences.en: Very well, because they're terrified of the horses.
sentences.zh: 非常能说明，因为他们对马感到恐惧。

sentences.en: Soto takes a gold ring off his finger and hands it to Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 索托从手指上摘下一枚金戒指，递给阿塔瓦尔帕。

sentences.en: And he says, with the translator speaking, he says, I give you this as a token of peace and friendship.
sentences.zh: 他说，通过翻译，他说，我把这个作为和平与友谊的象征送给你。

sentences.en: Atahualpa puts out his hand.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕伸出手。

sentences.en: He takes the ring, but he still won't meet Soto's eye and he doesn't show a flicker of emotion.
sentences.zh: 他接过了戒指，但仍然不与索托对视，也没有流露出一丝情绪。

sentences.en: And Soto then gives a prepared speech.
sentences.zh: 随后索托发表了一番准备好的演讲。

sentences.en: He says, I've come on behalf of a mighty king, King Charles.
sentences.zh: 他说，我是代表一位强大的国王，查理国王而来的。

sentences.en: He has appointed
sentences.zh: 他已经任命

sentences.en: Francisco Pizarro as governor of these lands.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗为这些土地的总督。

sentences.en: And Pizarro would be absolutely thrilled if you would come and see him in the town.
sentences.zh: 如果阁下能去镇上见他，皮萨罗会非常高兴的。

sentences.en: Atahualpa says nothing.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕什么也没说。

sentences.en: And he still doesn't raise his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他依然没有抬眼。

sentences.en: And one of his noblemen speaks up through the interpreter and says, the Sapa Inca is not going to be going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 他的一位贵族通过翻译开口说，萨帕·印卡哪里也不会去。

sentences.en: This is the last day of his ritual fast and celebration of his victory in the war.
sentences.zh: 今天是他在战争中获胜后的斋戒和庆祝活动的最后一天。

sentences.en: And he will not be accompanying you.
sentences.zh: 他不会陪你们去的。

sentences.en: And Hernando Pizarro at this point completely loses patience.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多·皮萨罗此时彻底失去了耐心。

sentences.en: And he says, for God's sake, man, when you look at us or whatever, he shouts at Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 他说，看在上帝的份上，伙计，当你看着我们或者什么的，他对着阿塔瓦尔帕大喊。

sentences.en: And now for the first time, Atahualpa raises his eyes to meet them.
sentences.zh: 现在，阿塔瓦尔帕第一次抬起眼睛看向他们。

sentences.en: His eyes are blazing with fury.
sentences.zh: 他的双眼燃烧着愤怒。

sentences.en: They are implacable.
sentences.zh: 它们是冷酷无情的。

sentences.en: And they are, if they could be cold and blazing, they're both blazing and cold.
sentences.zh: 如果眼神可以既冰冷又炽热，那它们既是炽热的又是冰冷的。

sentences.en: And his eyes meet theirs.
sentences.zh: 他的目光与他们相遇。

sentences.en: And now, at last, he speaks.
sentences.zh: 现在，他终于开口了。

sentences.en: Are you leaving us on that cliffhanger?
sentences.zh: 你要把我们留在这个悬念里吗？

sentences.en: On that.
