sentences.en: We are outside the town of Kamaka, and Anando de Soto and Anando Pizarro are face to face with the Emperor of the Incas, the redoubtable, terrifying Atahualpa with his, what was it
sentences.zh: 我们身处卡哈马卡镇外，埃尔南多·德·索托和埃尔南多·皮萨罗正与印加帝国皇帝面对面，那位令人敬畏、恐怖的阿塔瓦尔帕，还有他那，当时是怎么说的，

sentences.en: Dominic, his blazing and ice-cold eyes?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，他那双炽热又冰冷的眼睛？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, and so there's been a very tense standoff, and now Atahualpa has raised those blazing and ice-cold eyes to meet the eyes of the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 是的，当时气氛非常紧张，现在阿塔瓦尔帕抬起那双炽热又冰冷的眼睛，迎向了西班牙人的目光。

sentences.en: He's about to speak, and Dominic, what does he say?
sentences.zh: 他要开口了，多米尼克，他说了什么？

sentences.en: Nothing good.
sentences.zh: 没好话。

sentences.en: He says, I've heard complaints about you from my men in the north.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我从北方的部下那里听到了关于你们的抱怨。”

sentences.en: My captain in San Miguel sent to tell me that you've treated the chiefs badly and threw them into chains, and he sent me an iron collar.
sentences.zh: “我在圣米格尔的队长派人告诉我，你们虐待了酋长并将他们锁上铁链，他还给我送来了一个铁项圈。”

sentences.en: He says that he killed three Christians and one horse.
sentences.zh: “他说你们杀死了三个基督徒和一匹马。”

sentences.en: And Anando Pizarro now does all the talking.
sentences.zh: 现在由埃尔南多·皮萨罗负责交涉。

sentences.en: And he is a very undiplomatic man.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常不懂外交的人。

sentences.en: He says, your men in San Miguel were women.
sentences.zh: 他说：“你们在圣米格尔的部下简直是女人。”

sentences.en: They were no better than women.
sentences.zh: “他们和女人没什么两样。”

sentences.en: One horse was enough to conquer the whole land.
sentences.zh: “一匹马就足以征服整个土地。”

sentences.en: And when you see us fight, you will know what kind of men we are.
sentences.zh: “等你们看到我们战斗时，就会知道我们是什么样的人。”

sentences.en: And Atahualpa then says, and this goes back to something he was saying in the first half,
sentences.zh: 然后阿塔瓦尔帕说了一番话，这回到了他在上半部分提到的内容，

sentences.en: Tom.
sentences.zh: 汤姆。

sentences.en: He says, I could have stopped you coming, but I chose not to.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我本可以阻止你们到来，但我选择了不这样做。”

sentences.en: I know you are the sons of Viracocha.
sentences.zh: “我知道你们是维拉科查之子。”

sentences.en: You are messengers from our god-king, Pachacuti.
sentences.zh: “你们是我们神王帕查库蒂派来的使者。”

sentences.en: Your coming was foretold by my father, Juana Capac, so I gave orders that nobody was to stop or harm you.
sentences.zh: “我的父亲瓦伊纳·卡帕克预言了你们的到来，所以我下令任何人不得阻拦或伤害你们。”

sentences.en: But you think this is fabricated by a Spaniard who is muddling it up with what Moctezuma had said to Cortez, do you?
sentences.zh: 但你认为这是西班牙人编造的，混淆了蒙特祖马对科尔特斯说的话，对吗？

sentences.en: Or do you think this is authentically what he might have said?
sentences.zh: 还是你认为这确实是他可能说的话？

sentences.en: I think there are multiple explanations of this.
sentences.zh: 我认为这有多种解释。

sentences.en: So one of them is, he genuinely thinks they're messengers from the god-king, Pachacuti.
sentences.zh: 其中一种是，他真的认为他们是神王帕查库蒂派来的使者。

sentences.en: I think this is extremely unlikely.
sentences.zh: 我认为这极不可能。

sentences.en: Nothing that Atahualpa does, if he genuinely thought that, would he not have met their eyes earlier?
sentences.zh: 如果阿塔瓦尔帕真的这么想，他难道不会早点直视他们的眼睛吗？

sentences.en: Would he not be a bit more polite?
sentences.zh: 难道不会表现得更礼貌一点吗？

sentences.en: I think, of course, he would have behaved differently if he genuinely thought that.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果他真的那么想，他当然会表现得不同。

sentences.en: So I think there are two possibilities.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为有两种可能性。

sentences.en: One is that this is a literary flourish.
sentences.zh: 一种是这只是一种文学修辞。

sentences.en: And that, you know, this has now become the formula.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这已经成了某种套路。

sentences.en: That when you write a chronicle of Spanish conquest of somewhere in the Americas, the king greets you with these kinds of words.
sentences.zh: 当你撰写西班牙征服美洲某地的编年史时，国王总是会用这种话来迎接你。

sentences.en: And this is what the reader's like.
sentences.zh: 读者就喜欢看这个。

sentences.en: Number two is, he does say this.
sentences.zh: 第二种是，他确实说了这些话。

sentences.en: Actually, I think number two is probably right.
sentences.zh: 其实，我觉得第二种可能是对的。

sentences.en: He probably does say something a bit like this.
sentences.zh: 他可能确实说了类似这样的话。

sentences.en: And it's a courtesy.
sentences.zh: 这是一种客套话。

sentences.en: I would have said so too, because, I mean, who or what is Viracocha to the Spaniards?
sentences.zh: 我也会这么说，因为，我是说，维拉科查对西班牙人来说算什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, they don't care.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们根本不在乎。

sentences.en: It might be embellished or whatever.
sentences.zh: 这可能被润色过，或者别的什么。

sentences.en: I think it's a little bit like, to borrow what the great historian Matthew Restall said about when this happened in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这有点像借用伟大的历史学家马修·雷斯托尔在描述墨西哥发生类似事件时所说的话。

sentences.en: He said, it's a little bit like, it's an exaggerated version of when someone comes to your house and you say, oh, do what you like, you know, fête comme chez vous, you know, relax
sentences.zh: 他说，这有点像当有人来你家时，你客气地说“哦，随便点，就像在自己家一样”，你知道，放松

sentences.en: and enjoy.
sentences.zh: 享受就好。

sentences.en: You don't really mean it.
sentences.zh: 你并不是真的那个意思。

sentences.en: You don't mean do whatever you like.
sentences.zh: 你不是真的让他们随心所欲。

sentences.en: You say, you know, flowery things to make people feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 你只是说些客套话，让客人感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: And this is what Atahualpa is doing.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕做的就是这个。

sentences.en: Anyway, when he does this, Anando moderates his tone and he says, my brother, the governor, they always call Francisco Pizarro, the governor.
sentences.zh: 总之，当他这么说时，埃尔南多缓和了语气，他说：“我的兄弟，总督——他们总是称弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗为总督。”

sentences.en: Governor.
sentences.zh: 总督。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The governor loves you dearly.
sentences.zh: “总督非常爱戴你。”

sentences.en: If you have any enemies, we will send horsemen to deal with them for you.
sentences.zh: “如果你有任何敌人，我们会派骑兵为你解决他们。”

sentences.en: With 10 horsemen, we could defeat all your enemies.
sentences.zh: “只需 10 名骑兵，我们就能击败你所有的敌人。”

sentences.en: Your own men will only be needed to mop up the people who run away.
sentences.zh: “你们自己的人只需要负责清理那些逃跑的人就行了。”

sentences.en: And Anando says this to Atahualpa and Atahualpa just gives this cold smile.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多对阿塔瓦尔帕说了这些，阿塔瓦尔帕只是露出了冷笑。

sentences.en: And Anando himself, who wrote a memoir of it, recalls, he smiled as someone who did not think much of us.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多本人在回忆录中写道，他笑得就像一个根本没把我们放在眼里的人。

sentences.en: Of course, Atahualpa may be very excited by this deep down because he may be thinking, you know, these horses were a big deal.
sentences.zh: 当然，阿塔瓦尔帕内心深处可能对这些马感到非常兴奋，因为他可能在想，这些马可是大杀器。

sentences.en: And I could really finish off my brother's faction with these horses.
sentences.zh: 有了这些马，我真的可以彻底消灭我兄弟的派系。

sentences.en: And of course, he doesn't need the Spaniards to ride them in the lore.
sentences.zh: 当然，他不需要西班牙人骑着它们去作战。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He says, Atahualpa now says, will you dine with me?
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕接着说：“你们要和我一起用餐吗？”

sentences.en: And they say, no, we have to go back.
sentences.zh: 他们说：“不，我们得回去了。”

sentences.en: He says, well, you'd like drinks?
sentences.zh: 他说：“好吧，那喝点东西？”

sentences.en: I'll get, he gets women to bring them jugs of this beer, this chicha.
sentences.zh: 他让女人们拿来几罐这种啤酒，即奇恰酒。

sentences.en: And then the sun is setting and Atahualpa says, would you like to stay the night?
sentences.zh: 太阳快落山了，阿塔瓦尔帕说：“你们想留下来过夜吗？”

sentences.en: And Anando says, no, we'd like to go back to our friends in the town in Kayamarka.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多说：“不，我们想回到卡哈马卡镇的朋友那里去。”

sentences.en: And Atahualpa says, okay, you can stay in these barracks around the town square.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕说：“好吧，你们可以住在镇广场周围的营房里。”

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And then he says, I'll see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 然后他说：“明天见。”

sentences.en: Tomorrow, I'll come into Kayamarka to meet your leader.
sentences.zh: “明天，我会进入卡哈马卡去见你们的领袖。”

sentences.en: But there's one more moment before they leave.
sentences.zh: 但在他们离开前还有一个插曲。

sentences.en: Atahualpa clearly fascinated by the horses.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕显然对马匹非常着迷。

sentences.en: So, Anando de Soto, dressage champion of Spain, gives him a little riding demonstration.
sentences.zh: 于是，西班牙盛装舞步冠军埃尔南多·德·索托为他做了一次小小的骑术表演。

sentences.en: He wheels around on this horse.
sentences.zh: 他在马上转了个圈。

sentences.en: We're told that Atahualpa was amazed and amazed at seeing the agility with which it wheeled.
sentences.zh: 据说阿塔瓦尔帕对马匹转弯时的敏捷感到非常惊奇。

sentences.en: But the common people showed even greater admiration.
sentences.zh: 但普通百姓表现出了更大的钦佩。

sentences.en: There was much whispering.
sentences.zh: 人群中窃窃私语。

sentences.en: So there's clearly a little crowd.
sentences.zh: 显然围观的人不少。

sentences.en: One squadron of troops drew back when they saw the horse coming towards them.
sentences.zh: 当看到马向他们冲来时，有一队士兵退缩了。

sentences.en: And there's actually a dark side to this story.
sentences.zh: 这个故事其实还有阴暗的一面。

sentences.en: So when the Spanish had gone, Atahualpa says, those soldiers who drew back, round them all up, please, and execute them.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人走后，阿塔瓦尔帕说：“那些退缩的士兵，把他们都抓起来，处决掉。”

sentences.en: Because they showed fear.
sentences.zh: 因为他们表现出了恐惧。

sentences.en: And we can't show fear at the strangers' animals.
sentences.zh: “我们不能在陌生人的动物面前表现出恐惧。”

sentences.en: And some sources say, he said, find their wives and children and kill them too.
sentences.zh: 有些史料记载，他说：“把他们的妻儿也找出来杀掉。”

sentences.en: I want to make sure that nobody does this again.
sentences.zh: “我要确保没人再犯这种错。”

sentences.en: And that we don't show the slightest flicker of fear when we see the Spaniards' horses.
sentences.zh: “当我们看到西班牙人的马时，绝不能流露出一丝恐惧。”

sentences.en: So end the bloodline of these cowards.
sentences.zh: “所以，断绝这些懦夫的血脉。”

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You said that with real relish, Tom.
sentences.zh: 你说这话时真是津津有味啊，汤姆。

sentences.en: I could see you saying that, actually.
sentences.zh: 我甚至能想象出你当时说这话的样子。

sentences.en: If one of our producers showed fear of a horse.
sentences.zh: 如果我们的制作人表现出对马的恐惧。

sentences.en: I think that'd have been a good inker.
sentences.zh: 我想那会是个很好的墨水匠。

sentences.en: So, night falls in Cayamaca.
sentences.zh: 夜幕降临卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: But the Spanish can't sleep.
sentences.zh: 但西班牙人却无法入眠。

sentences.en: So Pizarro has a young cousin called Pedro who acted as his page.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗有个年轻的表亲叫佩德罗，担任他的侍从。

sentences.en: And Pedro described a council of war in Pizarro's quarters.
sentences.zh: 佩德罗描述了皮萨罗营地里的一次军事会议。

sentences.en: We took many views and opinions among ourselves about what should be done.
sentences.zh: 我们内部对该采取什么行动进行了各种讨论和权衡。

sentences.en: All were full of fear.
sentences.zh: 所有人心中都充满了恐惧。

sentences.en: For we were so few and so deep in the land where we could not be reinforced.
sentences.zh: 因为我们人数太少，又深入敌境，无法获得增援。

sentences.en: Of course, let's remind ourselves, there are 168 of them.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们要提醒自己，他们只有168人。

sentences.en: They are thousands of miles from help.
sentences.zh: 他们距离救援有数千英里之遥。

sentences.en: There are several million people between them and the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 在他们和海岸之间有数百万人。

sentences.en: And they are basically up against 80,000 Incas camped in the tents just outside the town.
sentences.zh: 而他们基本上要面对的是驻扎在城外帐篷里的8万印加人。

sentences.en: So quite a tight corner.
sentences.zh: 所以处境相当艰难。

sentences.en: It's, yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实，是这样。

sentences.en: The odds are against them, I think it's reasonable to say.
sentences.zh: 我认为可以说，胜算对他们很不利。

sentences.en: And Pizarro encourages his men, says, come on, we've got this.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗鼓励他的手下，说，来吧，我们能搞定。

sentences.en: We can do this.
sentences.zh: 我们能做到。

sentences.en: And one of the chronicles says, you know, that night he went around and he said, you know, every man a knight.
sentences.zh: 其中一部编年史记载，那天晚上他四处走动，对每个人说，人人都是骑士。

sentences.en: Every man is a knight.
sentences.zh: 人人都是骑士。

sentences.en: It's very like the Kingdom of Heaven, if you've seen that film.
sentences.zh: 这很像电影《天国王朝》，如果你看过那部电影的话。

sentences.en: The Orlando Bloom Crusades film, where at the end, he knights everybody in the defense of this city.
sentences.zh: 就是奥兰多·布鲁姆主演的那部十字军电影，结尾处他在守城时封所有人为骑士。

sentences.en: So even though he's saying all this, they must be thinking, Jesus, this is going to be tough.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管他这么说，他们心里肯定在想，天哪，这会是一场硬仗。

sentences.en: So the question is, what will they do when morning comes, when Atahualpa turns up?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，当早晨到来，阿塔瓦尔帕出现时，他们会怎么做？

sentences.en: Now, some Spanish chroniclers said later, Pizarro is hoping that Atahualpa will submit, will agree to accept Charles V as this overlord.
sentences.zh: 后来一些西班牙编年史家说，皮萨罗希望阿塔瓦尔帕会屈服，会同意接受查理五世作为他的领主。

sentences.en: And Jesus as the master of all.
sentences.zh: 并接受耶稣作为万物之主。

sentences.en: I think this is highly unlikely that Pizarro thought that would actually happen.
sentences.zh: 我认为皮萨罗认为这会发生是极不可能的。

sentences.en: I mean, he'd be mad if he thought that would happen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他认为这会发生，那他就是疯了。

sentences.en: I think he was always going to use some form of violence.
sentences.zh: 我认为他一直打算使用某种形式的暴力。

sentences.en: He knew what his cousin Cortez had done in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他知道他的表亲科尔特斯在墨西哥做了什么。

sentences.en: And as Matthew Restle says in his excellent books about the Spanish conquest of the Americas,
sentences.zh: 正如马修·雷斯特尔在他关于西班牙征服美洲的优秀著作中所说，

sentences.en: standard practice was theatrical terror.
sentences.zh: 标准的做法是戏剧性的恐怖手段。

sentences.en: You strike first, you use surprise, you use your military technology, which is your horses, your swords, and so on.
sentences.zh: 你先发制人，利用突袭，利用你的军事技术，也就是你的马匹、剑等等。

sentences.en: And your guns.
sentences.zh: 还有你的枪。

sentences.en: Yeah, and your guns.
sentences.zh: 是的，还有你的枪。

sentences.en: And you hope that that will prevail.
sentences.zh: 你希望这样能奏效。

sentences.en: You can frighten people into acquiescing.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过恐吓让人屈服。

sentences.en: And so this is what Pizarro says to his men.
sentences.zh: 这就是皮萨罗对他手下说的话。

sentences.en: He says, look, we're going to take advantage of the geography.
sentences.zh: 他说，看，我们要利用地理优势。

sentences.en: When Atahualpa and his men arrive, we'll allow them to filter into the main square.
sentences.zh: 当阿塔瓦尔帕和他的手下到达时，我们让他们进入主广场。

sentences.en: Whereas you rightly said, Tom, there's a platform in the middle.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才正确指出的，汤姆，中间有一个平台。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa will probably go up onto the platform or something like that.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕可能会走上平台之类的。

sentences.en: We'll see.
sentences.zh: 我们走着瞧。

sentences.en: Now, meanwhile, we will be in the barracks, which are on three sides of the square.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们将待在广场三面的营房里。

sentences.en: Everyone will wait for my signal to burst out of the doorways.
sentences.zh: 所有人都要等我的信号，然后从门口冲出来。

sentences.en: On two sides, we'll have most of the horses under Soto and my brother Hernando and the other big Jesus.
sentences.zh: 在两侧，我们将由索托、我的兄弟埃尔南多和其他大人物带领大部分骑兵。

sentences.en: And they can deal with the Inca troops.
sentences.zh: 他们可以对付印加军队。

sentences.en: On the third side, I'll be there with a smaller group of people.
sentences.zh: 在第三面，我会带着一小群人守在那里。

sentences.en: And our job is to snatch Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 我们的任务是抓住阿塔瓦尔帕。

sentences.en: And as for the rest of the men, and we're not talking about huge numbers, you hide in the alleys around the square.
sentences.zh: 至于其他人，我们谈论的人数并不多，你们躲在广场周围的小巷里。

sentences.en: When the fighting starts, try to seal off the square.
sentences.zh: 战斗开始时，试着封锁广场。

sentences.en: And that will mean that the Incas can't escape and they'll be at the mercy of our cavalry.
sentences.zh: 这意味着印加人无法逃脱，他们将任由我们的骑兵宰割。

sentences.en: And as for the signal, when Atahualpa is taking his place in the center of the square,
sentences.zh: 至于信号，当阿塔瓦尔帕在广场中央就位时，

sentences.en: Pedro de Candia, the guy from Crete, the artilleryman, he can fire his guns, blow a load of trumpets.
sentences.zh: 来自克里特岛的炮兵佩德罗·德·坎迪亚，他可以开火，吹响号角。

sentences.en: And when you hear that, it's game on.
sentences.zh: 当你听到那个声音，比赛就开始了。

sentences.en: And we'll do this.
sentences.zh: 我们要干这一票。

sentences.en: And Pedro de Candia is on this raised platform, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 佩德罗·德·坎迪亚是在那个高台上，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, he is.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: He's on the platform.
sentences.zh: 他在平台上。

sentences.en: So kind of relatively speaking, commanding heights.
sentences.zh: 所以相对而言，占据了制高点。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Now, Miguel de Estete, who's one of the memoirists, described the mood after the meeting broke up and darkness drew him.
sentences.zh: 米格尔·德·埃斯特特是回忆录作者之一，他描述了会议结束后夜幕降临时的气氛。

sentences.en: Few slept.
sentences.zh: 几乎没人睡觉。

sentences.en: And we kept watching the square from which the campfires of the Indian army could be seen.
sentences.zh: 我们一直盯着广场，从那里可以看到印加军队的营火。

sentences.en: It was a terrible sight.
sentences.zh: 那景象太可怕了。

sentences.en: Most of them were on a hillside and close to one another.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数人在山坡上，彼此靠得很近。

sentences.en: It looked like a brilliantly star-studded sky.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像繁星点点的天空。

sentences.en: So they're kind of looking out at these campfires, these tents, and they're absolutely, the Spanish, you know, they're absolutely terrified.
sentences.zh: 所以他们看着那些营火和帐篷，西班牙人真的，你知道，他们被吓坏了。

sentences.en: So the hours pass.
sentences.zh: 时间一分一秒地过去。

sentences.en: They don't get much sleep.
sentences.zh: 他们没怎么睡。

sentences.en: Dawn breaks, the 16th of November, 1532.
sentences.zh: 黎明破晓，1532年11月16日。

sentences.en: Atahualpa's ritual fast is over.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕的仪式性斋戒结束了。

sentences.en: He and his closest friends have been drinking to mark the end of the faSt.
sentences.zh: 他和最亲近的朋友们一直在喝酒，以庆祝斋戒结束。

sentences.en: He's in no hurry to go anywhere, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实他一点也不急着去哪里。

sentences.en: Probably got a bit of a hangover.
sentences.zh: 可能还有点宿醉。

sentences.en: So all morning, the Spanish wait.
sentences.zh: 所以整个上午，西班牙人都在等待。

sentences.en: Their Dominicans have held mass.
sentences.zh: 他们的多米尼加修士举行了弥撒。

sentences.en: Everything is ready.
sentences.zh: 一切准备就绪。

sentences.en: The tension, you know, mounting all the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，紧张气氛一直在加剧。

sentences.en: A messenger arrives mid-morning from Atahualpa's camp, and he says,
sentences.zh: 上午过半时，阿塔瓦尔帕的营地来了一名信使，他说，

sentences.en: Atahualpa's still coming.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕还在路上。

sentences.en: He's coming with his men, and his men will be armed.
sentences.zh: 他带着手下过来，而且他的手下会携带武器。

sentences.en: Pizarro says, fine, you can come however he likes.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗说，没关系，他想怎么来都行。

sentences.en: I will welcome him as a friend and a brother.
sentences.zh: 我会像朋友和兄弟一样欢迎他。

sentences.en: That's nice.
sentences.zh: 那很好。

sentences.en: Another hour goes by.
sentences.zh: 又过了一个小时。

sentences.en: No one comes.
sentences.zh: 没有人来。

sentences.en: Then another messenger arrives, and he says, actually, they've changed their mind.
sentences.zh: 然后又来了一名信使，他说，其实他们改变主意了。

sentences.en: They're going to leave their weapons behind.
sentences.zh: 他们打算把武器留在后面。

sentences.en: And why is that, do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是为什么？

sentences.en: I genuinely don't know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: I think it never really occurs to Atahualpa that he'd need the weapons.
sentences.zh: 我想阿塔瓦尔帕根本没想过他需要武器。

sentences.en: He's got so many men.
sentences.zh: 他有那么多人。

sentences.en: Yeah, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我想也是。

sentences.en: There's so many men.
sentences.zh: 人太多了。

sentences.en: I mean, the Spanish would be mad to attack him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，西班牙人要是攻击他就是疯了。

sentences.en: Just thinks highly.
sentences.zh: 只是太自负了。

sentences.en: 168 men against 80,000.
sentences.zh: 168人对阵8万人。

sentences.en: I mean, you'd never do that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你永远不会那么做。

sentences.en: Still, they don't come, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们还是没来。

sentences.en: At midday, there's movement in Atahualpa's camp, and the Spanish lookouts say, the entire plain is full of men.
sentences.zh: 中午时分，阿塔瓦尔帕的营地有了动静，西班牙哨兵说，整个平原上都是人。

sentences.en: Now, Pizarro's men have all taken their places in the barracks and hiding and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 现在，皮萨罗的人都已在营房和藏身处就位了。

sentences.en: And you can imagine how nervous they are now.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象他们现在有多紧张。

sentences.en: Pedro Pizarro said, I saw many Spaniards urinate without noticing it, out of pure terror.
sentences.zh: 佩德罗·皮萨罗说，我看到许多西班牙人因为极度恐惧，甚至没察觉到自己尿了裤子。

sentences.en: So the Incas start to advance towards the town.
sentences.zh: 于是印加人开始向城镇推进。

sentences.en: And I quote, they all wore large gold and silver discs like crowns on their heads.
sentences.zh: 我引用一下，他们头上都戴着像皇冠一样的大金银圆盘。

sentences.en: They were apparently all coming in their ceremonial clothes with a livery of checkered colors like a chessboard.
sentences.zh: 他们显然都穿着礼服，上面有像棋盘一样的方格花纹。

sentences.en: And as they march, the Incas are kind of doing this motion to sweep the ground as if clearing rubbish off the ground or something.
sentences.zh: 当他们行进时，印加人似乎在做一种扫地的动作，好像在清理地上的垃圾之类的。

sentences.en: And they're singing a song, which the Spanish don't understand.
sentences.zh: 他们还在唱一首歌，西班牙人听不懂。

sentences.en: But one of them said, it was by no means lacking grace for those of us who heard it.
sentences.zh: 但其中一人说，对于我们这些听众来说，这首歌一点也不缺乏优雅。

sentences.en: Half a mile outside the town, the Incas stop.
sentences.zh: 在城外半英里处，印加人停了下来。

sentences.en: And Pizarro can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: He sends out an interpreter.
sentences.zh: 他派出了一个翻译。

sentences.en: Why have you stopped?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么停下？

sentences.en: And Atahualpa's men say, well, we've been told to halt.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕的人说，我们接到命令要停下。

sentences.en: It's mid-afternoon now.
sentences.zh: 现在已经是下午了。

sentences.en: And the emperor has decided he'd like to spend the night outside the city and come in tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 皇帝决定在城外过夜，明天再进城。

sentences.en: And Pizarro is horrified by that.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗对此感到惊恐。

sentences.en: He doesn't want the Incas right outside the town overnight.
sentences.zh: 他不希望印加人在夜间就驻扎在城外。

sentences.en: Because the one thing the Spanish are dreading is a night attack.
sentences.zh: 因为西班牙人最害怕的就是夜袭。

sentences.en: And he sends another Spaniard to go and implore Atahualpa, please come and visit us before nightfall.
sentences.zh: 他派了另一个西班牙人去恳求阿塔瓦尔帕，请在天黑前过来拜访我们。

sentences.en: You know, we won't harm you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不会伤害你。

sentences.en: We won't hurt you.
sentences.zh: 我们不会伤害你。

sentences.en: You can come without fear.
sentences.zh: 你可以放心过来。

sentences.en: As a slightly weird thing to say, why would Atahualpa be frightened?
sentences.zh: 这话说得有点奇怪，阿塔瓦尔帕为什么要害怕？

sentences.en: There's no reason for him to be afraid.
sentences.zh: 他没有理由害怕。

sentences.en: The Spanish are rather giving themselves away there, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想西班牙人在这里有点暴露自己的心思了。

sentences.en: They are, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 确实是这样，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's betraying their secret thoughts.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这暴露了他们内心的秘密想法。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Exactly it is.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Anyway, the sun is beginning to sink.
sentences.zh: 总之，太阳开始下山了。

sentences.en: And at last, Atahualpa moves.
sentences.zh: 最后，阿塔瓦尔帕动身了。

sentences.en: He advances now with about 6,000 men, leaving most of his army outside the town.
sentences.zh: 他现在带着大约6000人前进，把大部分军队留在了城外。

sentences.en: His men, as they promised, have left their, as it were, the heavier weapons behind.
sentences.zh: 正如他们承诺的那样，他的手下把所谓的重型武器留在了后面。

sentences.en: They've got slings.
sentences.zh: 他们有投石索。

sentences.en: They've got stones.
sentences.zh: 他们有石头。

sentences.en: And they've got little axes.
sentences.zh: 他们还有小斧头。

sentences.en: Maybe kind of ceremonial axes, almoSt.
sentences.zh: 也许算是某种礼仪斧头。

sentences.en: They come through the gate.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过大门。

sentences.en: They come along the street.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着街道走来。

sentences.en: At last, they enter the central square.
sentences.zh: 终于，他们进入了中心广场。

sentences.en: The vanguard, then the emperor's party, many of them wearing these big feathered headdresses and stuff, and Atahualpa himself.
sentences.zh: 先头部队，然后是皇帝的随从，他们许多人戴着巨大的羽毛头饰之类的，还有阿塔瓦尔帕本人。

sentences.en: He is sitting, and I quote, on a very fine litter, lined with feathers of many colours and embellished with plates of gold and silver.
sentences.zh: 他坐着，引用原文，坐在一顶非常精致的轿子上，衬着五颜六色的羽毛，装饰着金银板。

sentences.en: Eighty lords carried him on their shoulders, all wearing a very rich blue livery.
sentences.zh: 八十位贵族抬着他的肩膀，都穿着非常华丽的蓝色制服。

sentences.en: He was seated on the litter, on a small stool with a rich saddle cushion, very richly dressed, with his crown on his head and a collar of large emeralds around his neck.
sentences.zh: 他坐在轿子上的一个小凳子上，上面有华丽的马鞍垫，穿着非常华丽，头上戴着皇冠，脖子上戴着一串大祖母绿项链。

sentences.en: Very like Montezuma on the causeway being brought out to meet Enn and Cortez.
sentences.zh: 这很像蒙特祖马在堤道上被抬出来迎接恩和科尔特斯的情景。

sentences.en: I mean, it is amazing how many parallels between those two stories there are.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这两个故事之间的相似之处多得惊人。

sentences.en: It is, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 确实是这样，不是吗？

sentences.en: I agree completely.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意。

sentences.en: You do wonder, did it actually happen?
sentences.zh: 你确实会想，这真的发生过吗？

sentences.en: Or are the two accounts bleeding into one another?
sentences.zh: 还是说这两种说法在相互渗透？

sentences.en: They're not making it up, but...
sentences.zh: 他们并不是在编造，但是……

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the two accounts do bleed into each other a bit, actually.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我觉得这两种说法确实在一定程度上相互渗透了。

sentences.en: I think that's what makes it quite hard to discern the truth.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是导致真相难以辨明的原因。

sentences.en: That said, there are enough Spanish accounts of this incident...
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，关于这次事件的西班牙语记录已经足够多了……

sentences.en: Oh, of course.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: ...for us not to doubt it.
sentences.zh: ……足以让我们不再怀疑它的真实性。

sentences.en: And the example of what Cortez did with Montezuma is obviously an inspiration here.
sentences.zh: 而科尔特斯对待蒙特祖马的方式显然是这里的灵感来源。

sentences.en: Completely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So the sun has now almost set.
sentences.zh: 太阳现在几乎已经落山了。

sentences.en: There are thousands of Incas in the square.
sentences.zh: 广场上有成千上万的印加人。

sentences.en: Atahualpa signals from the litter, and he's raised up high above people's heads.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕在轿子上发出信号，他被高高地抬起，凌驾于众人的头顶之上。

sentences.en: And one of his captains steps forward with his personal standard, as if to claim this kind of central platform.
sentences.zh: 他的一位队长带着他的个人旗帜走上前去，仿佛要宣示这个中央平台的主权。

sentences.en: Now, what is Atahualpa thinking at this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，阿塔瓦尔帕此刻在想什么呢？

sentences.en: Everything we know of him is that he is a very ruthless and proud, and if necessary, violent man.
sentences.zh: 我们对他的一切了解都表明，他是一个非常冷酷、傲慢，且在必要时会诉诸暴力的人。

sentences.en: I don't think he senses any danger.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他感觉到了任何危险。

sentences.en: I think he thinks the Spanish are shambles and are undisciplined.
sentences.zh: 我认为他觉得西班牙人是一群乌合之众，毫无纪律可言。

sentences.en: I think his plan is that at some point this evening, he will take Pizarro prisoner.
sentences.zh: 我想他的计划是，在今晚的某个时刻，他会把皮萨罗抓起来。

sentences.en: Possibly he will kill him.
sentences.zh: 可能他会杀了他。

sentences.en: Possibly he will kill the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 可能他会杀了那些西班牙人。

sentences.en: But what he wants are the horses to use in his war.
sentences.zh: 但他想要的是那些马匹，以便在战争中使用。

sentences.en: What he doesn't expect is that the Spaniards won't be there.
sentences.zh: 他没料到的是，西班牙人根本不在那儿。

sentences.en: And he calls out in Quechua, where are they?
sentences.zh: 他用克丘亚语喊道，他们在哪儿？

sentences.en: You know, where are you?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你们在哪儿？

sentences.en: And two Spaniards come out of one of these barracks.
sentences.zh: 然后两个西班牙人从其中一个营房里走了出来。

sentences.en: One of them is a guy called Hernando Daldana, who had learned a little Quechua, so he could work as a, he could help with the interpreting.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是叫埃尔南多·达尔达纳的家伙，他学过一点克丘亚语，所以他可以担任翻译，或者说协助翻译工作。

sentences.en: And the other is the Dominican friar,
sentences.zh: 另一个是多米尼加修士，

sentences.en: Vicente de Valverde.
sentences.zh: 文森特·德·瓦尔韦德。

sentences.en: Great to have a Valverde back on the show.
sentences.zh: 很高兴节目里又出现了一位瓦尔韦德。

sentences.en: And he is with one of these interpreters, either Martinio or Filippio.
sentences.zh: 他带着其中一名翻译，不是马丁尼奥就是菲利皮奥。

sentences.en: And he is holding a cross in one hand and a prayer book in the other, and he advances towards Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 他一手拿着十字架，一手拿着祈祷书，向阿塔瓦尔帕走去。

sentences.en: And there are different accounts, very confusing accounts of what happened next.
sentences.zh: 关于接下来发生了什么，有各种不同的、非常令人困惑的说法。

sentences.en: But here is, I think, a way through.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，这里有一条理清思路的方法。

sentences.en: Valverde kicks off by saying to Atahualpa, would you like to come inside and have dinner with Francisco Pizarro?
sentences.zh: 瓦尔韦德首先对阿塔瓦尔帕说，你想进来和弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗共进晚餐吗？
zh_words: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗共进

sentences.en: And this is obviously a ploy to get him apart from his men.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个将他与部下隔离开来的计谋。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa says, no.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕说，不。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa says straight away, he's less conciliatory today.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕直截了当地拒绝了，他今天表现得没那么妥协。

sentences.en: And he says, I've come to tell you to return everything you've stolen since you entered my kingdom.
sentences.zh: 他说，我来是告诉你们，归还你们进入我王国以来所窃取的一切。

sentences.en: I mean, clearly, I think this is, he's getting gearing up for a fight.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很明显，我觉得他这是在为战斗做准备。

sentences.en: And Valverde, who must have been very nervous, begins to recite something.
sentences.zh: 而一定非常紧张的瓦尔韦德开始背诵什么东西。

sentences.en: And the interpreter is translating all the time.
sentences.zh: 翻译一直在进行翻译。

sentences.en: And Valverde says, I'm a minister of ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔韦德说，我是基督的牧师。

sentences.en: And he starts gabbling about the history of the world.
sentences.zh: 他开始喋喋不休地讲述世界历史。

sentences.en: Jesus came into the world, crucified to save sinners.
sentences.zh: 耶稣来到世间，为了拯救罪人而被钉死在十字架上。

sentences.en: My king, Charles V, has sent me to tell you all about this.
sentences.zh: 我的国王查理五世派我来告诉你这一切。

sentences.en: You must accept Christ as your master in heaven.
sentences.zh: 你必须接受基督作为你在天上的主。

sentences.en: You must accept my king, Charles V, as your master on earth.
sentences.zh: 你必须接受我的国王查理五世作为你在地上的主。

sentences.en: You must become his vassal.
sentences.zh: 你必须成为他的附庸。

sentences.en: You must give up your gods.
sentences.zh: 你必须放弃你的神灵。

sentences.en: And if you don't,
sentences.zh: 如果你不这样做，

sentences.en: quote, if you refuse and seek to resist, then you and all your people will be destroyed, just as the pharaoh of old and all his hosts perished in the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 引用原文，如果你拒绝并试图反抗，那么你和你所有的子民都将被毁灭，就像古代的法老和他的所有大军在红海中覆灭一样。

sentences.en: I mean, if the translator is interpreting all this,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果翻译在翻译所有这些内容，

sentences.en: Atahualpa,
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕，

sentences.en: Atahualpa must have been listening to this thinking, what is this?
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕听着这些话，一定在想，这是什么？

sentences.en: I can't believe he said that.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信他说了这些。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, of course, it just seems extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 是啊，当然，这看起来太不可思议了。

sentences.en: But it's signaling how the Spaniards will cast the downfall of Atahualpa, right?
sentences.zh: 但这标志着西班牙人将如何描述阿塔瓦尔帕的垮台，对吧？

sentences.en: Of course, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，当然。

sentences.en: Now, I think what Valverde is doing, I think what a lot of historians think what Valverde is doing, is he is reciting a version of the requirement,
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为瓦尔韦德所做的事情，也是许多历史学家认为瓦尔韦德所做的事情，就是他在背诵一份《要求书》的变体，

sentences.en: which is this bizarre legal document we mentioned already, that since 1513,
sentences.zh: 也就是我们之前提到的那份奇怪的法律文件，自1513年以来，

sentences.en: Spanish captains are legally bound to read out to the peoples of the Americas before they kill them.
sentences.zh: 西班牙船长在杀人之前，法律规定必须向美洲人民宣读这份文件。

sentences.en: Now, even at the time when the Council of Castilla approved this, lots of Spaniards said, are you mad?
sentences.zh: 当时，即使是卡斯蒂利亚议会批准这份文件时，许多西班牙人也说，你们疯了吗？

sentences.en: You're going to read this out to people before you attack them.
sentences.zh: 你们要在攻击别人之前给他们读这个。

sentences.en: I mean, expect them to understand it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，指望他们能听懂。

sentences.en: And of course, the interpreters are useless in Cayamaca, so they're kind of mistranslating things.
sentences.zh: 当然，在卡哈马卡，翻译们根本没用，所以他们翻译得乱七八糟。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa, listening to this, must have just thought, what?
sentences.zh: 而阿塔瓦尔帕听着这些，一定只会想，什么？

sentences.en: Gibberish.
sentences.zh: 胡言乱语。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Now, Atahualpa is looking confused, angry, impatient.
sentences.zh: 现在，阿塔瓦尔帕看起来很困惑、愤怒且不耐烦。

sentences.en: And Valverde says, perhaps you'd like to have a look at my prayer book.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔韦德说，也许你想看看我的祈祷书。

sentences.en: Making chat.
sentences.zh: 闲聊。

sentences.en: Small talk.
sentences.zh: 寒暄。

sentences.en: Atahualpa, to stress, has never seen a book before or writing of any kind.
sentences.zh: 需要强调的是，阿塔瓦尔帕以前从未见过书或任何形式的文字。

sentences.en: Well, no, because he's only got cords with knots in, hasn't he?
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有，因为他只有带结的绳子，不是吗？

sentences.en: Cords with knots.
sentences.zh: 带结的绳子。

sentences.en: Valverde gives him the book, and it's one of those books that must have like a buckle or a clip or a lock or something like that on it.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔韦德把书给了他，那书上一定有扣子、夹子、锁之类的东西。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa tries to open it, and he can't open it.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕试着打开它，却打不开。

sentences.en: He's never seen an object like this.
sentences.zh: 他从未见过这样的东西。

sentences.en: And Valverde reaches out to help him.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔韦德伸手去帮他。

sentences.en: Atahualpa hits him contemptuously, manages to open the book, and stares at it.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕轻蔑地拍开他的手，设法打开了书，盯着它看。

sentences.en: And we are told, he looked with great interest at the construction of the book, the sort of what it was.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，他饶有兴致地观察了书的结构，那种东西是什么。

sentences.en: But obviously, he doesn't know that these symbols are words or that there's a story or that they are prayers or whatever.
sentences.zh: 但显然，他不知道这些符号是文字，也不知道里面有什么故事、祈祷文之类的东西。

sentences.en: It's just madness to him.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这简直是疯了。

sentences.en: Now, what happens next is unclear.
sentences.zh: 现在，接下来发生了什么还不清楚。

sentences.en: Some people say Atahualpa threw the book down in the dust with contempt.
sentences.zh: 有些人说阿塔瓦尔帕轻蔑地把书扔进了尘土里。

sentences.en: Some say that actually Valverde took the book back and dropped it or dropped it while handing it to him or something like this.
sentences.zh: 有些人说其实是瓦尔韦德拿回书时掉在了地上，或者是在递给他时掉落的，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Anyway, at some point, the book ends up on the ground in the dust, and this is the pretext that the Spanish need.
sentences.zh: 总之，在某个时刻，书掉在了尘土里，这就是西班牙人所需要的借口。

sentences.en: Atahualpa shouts something to his own men, but Valverde is already running back to the barracks and he's shouting to Bizarro, come out, come out,
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕向他的人大喊着什么，但瓦尔韦德已经跑回营房，向皮萨罗大喊，出来，出来，

sentences.en: Christians.
sentences.zh: 基督徒们。

sentences.en: The dogs have rejected the word of God.
sentences.zh: 这些狗拒绝了上帝的话语。

sentences.en: That proud dog has thrown my book of holy law to the ground.
sentences.zh: 那条骄傲的狗把我的圣法书扔到了地上。

sentences.en: He has become a Lucifer.
sentences.zh: 他已经变成了路西法。

sentences.en: All words to that effect.
sentences.zh: 大致就是这些话。

sentences.en: That is the trigger for Pedro de Candia on the platform to fire his guns into the crowd.
sentences.zh: 这就是佩德罗·德·坎迪亚在平台上向人群开火的信号。

sentences.en: At the Incas.
sentences.zh: 向印加人开火。

sentences.en: At the Incas.
sentences.zh: 向印加人开火。

sentences.en: Now, of course, the Incas must have seen the guns, but they didn't know what they were.
sentences.zh: 当然，印加人一定看到了枪，但他们不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: So what a shock that is.
sentences.zh: 所以那该是多么大的震惊啊。

sentences.en: Suddenly the guns, there's a huge bang, bang, bang.
sentences.zh: 突然间枪声大作，砰，砰，砰。

sentences.en: The Incas are reeling in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 印加人在人群中摇晃。

sentences.en: Then Pedro de Candia says, sound the trumpets.
sentences.zh: 然后佩德罗·德·坎迪亚说，吹响号角。

sentences.en: The trumpets blast, so there's a sort of sensory overload.
sentences.zh: 号角齐鸣，这是一种感官上的超负荷。

sentences.en: And it's at that point that the Spanish horsemen burst out of the barracks on their horses.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，西班牙骑兵骑着马从营房里冲了出来。

sentences.en: They've got their swords drawn.
sentences.zh: 他们拔出了剑。

sentences.en: They're all screaming,
sentences.zh: 他们都在尖叫，

sentences.en: Santiago,
sentences.zh: 圣地亚哥，

sentences.en: Santiago, which is their kind of war cry.
sentences.zh: 圣地亚哥，这是他们的战吼。

sentences.en: And it's very like the bit at the end of the two towers, helms deep, when the riders of Rohan kind of burst out of the fortress, cutting a swathe through the orcs.
sentences.zh: 这非常像《双塔奇兵》结尾圣盔谷的那一幕，洛汗骑兵从堡垒中冲出，在半兽人中杀出一条血路。

sentences.en: This is the scene in the square.
sentences.zh: 这就是广场上的场景。

sentences.en: So the Spanish have tied bells and rattles to their horses' bridles to make the maximum possible noise.
sentences.zh: 所以西班牙人在马的缰绳上系了铃铛和拨浪鼓，以制造最大的噪音。

sentences.en: And the Incas, of course, who are not used to horses, who are frightened of horses, straight away, they're in total chaos.
sentences.zh: 而印加人当然不习惯马，他们害怕马，立刻陷入了彻底的混乱。

sentences.en: They're screaming, they're running everywhere, they're stampeding and crushing each other.
sentences.zh: 他们尖叫着，到处乱跑，践踏并挤压着彼此。

sentences.en: Well, it's come as a complete surprise, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这完全是个意外，对吧？

sentences.en: Total surprise.
sentences.zh: 完全出乎意料。

sentences.en: The Spanish have come from nowhere.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人从天而降。

sentences.en: Guns, horses, this is stuff they've never seen before.
sentences.zh: 枪支、马匹，这些都是他们从未见过的东西。

sentences.en: The swords are flashing, the Incas are slipping and falling everywhere, there's bodies piling up, there's blood everywhere, people are literally suffocating each other in the crush
sentences.zh: 刀剑闪烁，印加人到处滑倒摔倒，尸体堆积如山，到处都是血，人们在拥挤中简直是在窒息而死，

sentences.en: and the carnage.
sentences.zh: 还有那场大屠杀。

sentences.en: And when they get to the ends, to the gates, to the ways out of the square,
sentences.zh: 当他们到达尽头，到达大门，到达离开广场的出口时，

sentences.en: Pizarro's other men are there, swords drawn to block them.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗的其他部下就在那里，拔出剑挡住他们的去路。

sentences.en: Now, some of the Incas managed to break through a low wall and to get out of the square into the fields beyond.
sentences.zh: 现在，一些印加人设法冲破了一堵矮墙，逃出了广场，进入了外面的田野。

sentences.en: So thousands of people start streaming out into the fields, but the Spanish horsemen are following them out and the captains are shouting, and I quote, ride them down,
sentences.zh: 于是成千上万的人开始涌入田野，但西班牙骑兵在后面追赶，队长们大喊着，我引用一下，骑马追上他们，

sentences.en: don't let any of them escape.
sentences.zh: 别让任何一个人逃掉。

sentences.en: And this is a scene of utter slaughter.
sentences.zh: 这是一场彻底的屠杀场景。

sentences.en: The cavalry riding them down one by one, without mercy, cutting them down.
sentences.zh: 骑兵们一个接一个地追赶他们，毫不留情地砍杀。

sentences.en: The whole thing takes two hours and it is a complete and utter walkover.
sentences.zh: 整个过程持续了两个小时，这是一场彻底的、完全的一边倒的战斗。

sentences.en: The Wikipedia entry calls it the Battle of Chiamaque.
sentences.zh: 维基百科的条目称之为卡哈马卡战役。

sentences.en: But it's not a battle.
sentences.zh: 但这根本不是一场战役。

sentences.en: But it's not a battle.
sentences.zh: 但这根本不是一场战役。

sentences.en: It's a complete massacre.
sentences.zh: 这是一场彻底的大屠杀。

sentences.en: So Spanish sources themselves said, you know, once the cavalry had done their work and then burst out following the people who were running away, the foot soldiers
sentences.zh: 所以西班牙人自己的记载也说，你知道，一旦骑兵完成了他们的工作，然后冲出来追赶那些逃跑的人，步兵们

sentences.en: went into the square and they put every single person there to the sword.
